The prompt emphasizes lighting (golden hour, rim lighting), composition (off-center, telephoto lens aesthetic), and mood (introspective, minimal elegance).

```
Create a vertical 3:4 high-end editorial portrait, (using the attached image strictly as the facial identity reference.) A lone subject stands immersed in a vast field of golden wheat at peak harvest, with tall yellow stalks surrounding them completely. The wheat moves fluidly in the wind, creating elegant wave-like motion that partially frames and reveals the subject, adding depth and visual richness.
The subject wears a clean, minimal, slightly oversized white shirt styled like a fashion editorial. Their dark hair is naturally tousled, gently lifted by the wind for an effortless, styled look. The head is slightly lowered with the gaze directed downward, conveying a calm, introspective, and emotionally controlled mood — subtle yet powerful.

Add subtle rim lighting from behind to separate the subject from the background and create a premium, dimensional look.
Use a refined warm color palette of golden yellow, soft amber, and creamy whites. Maintain a telephoto lens aesthetic with shallow depth of field, sharp subject focus, and softly blurred wheat in motion. Include film-like grain, soft vignette, and controlled contrast for a polished magazine finish.
The final image should feel like a Vogue-level outdoor editorial elegant, minimal, emotionally deep, and visually striking. Ultra-detailed, realistic, and professionally styled with a cinematic storytelling touch.
```

## 307. Cinematic 3D Toy Character Evolution Sequence

- **id**：12818
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=12818

### 描述

A highly structured prompt for generating a cinematic image showing the evolution of a 3D toy character across 6-8 stages in a single frame, emphasizing absolute likeness integrity, diagonal composition, progressive motion, and dramatic lighting to highlight the final, evolved form.

### 示例图

![Cinematic 3D Toy Character Evolution Sequence](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1774679870450_xwz2vk_HEZWIrwXgAEA-3_.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A cinematic evolution sequence of the 3d toy character shown as multiple identical instances progressing from primitive to fully realized form across a single frame.
🔒 LIKENESS INTEGRITY (ABSOLUTE PRIORITY)

All instances must preserve exactly:

• proportions

• eye shape, spacing, stylization

• silhouette

• material identity
No redesign. No added features. No anatomy change. Only pose progression is allowed.
🧠 EVOLUTION STRUCTURE (MANDATORY)

The character appears repeated in a left-to-right progression of 6–8 stages:

• earliest stage: crouched, compressed, almost animalistic or inactive

• mid stages: gradual spine lift, awareness, balance emerging

• final stage: fully upright, confident forward motion
Each stage must feel like a natural transformation, not separate poses.

Motion must read as a continuous evolution.
🎥 CAMERA & PERSPECTIVE

Low-angle cinematic shot, slightly below mid-body height of the final character

Shot with a 28–35mm lens to create subtle perspective compression and depth

Camera positioned closer to the final evolved character, making it dominant in frame

The earliest forms recede into the background along a diagonal progression
⚖️ COMPOSITION (CRITICAL)

Diagonal layout from back-left (primitive) → front-right (evolved)

Foreground dominated by the final form, partially cropped for tension

Earlier stages progressively smaller and more compressed into depth

No centered symmetry
🎯 DEPTH OF FIELD (MANDATORY)

Primary focal plane locked on the most evolved character

Mid stages slightly softer

Earliest stages fall into progressive blur
No full-frame sharpness
💡 LIGHTING

Strong directional light from the side or rear

Rim light increases progressively across evolution stages

Primitive forms sit more in shadow

Final form is clearly defined with sculptural light separation
🌫 ATMOSPHERE

Subtle haze or volumetric light to enhance depth layering

Light falloff increases toward background

Optional faint dust or particles to create dimensional space
🎨 COLOR CONTROL

Primitive stages slightly desaturated and darker

Color richness increases toward the final evolved form

Controlled contrast, no oversaturation
🧱 SURFACE & MATERIAL

Maintain exact original material identity

Enhance micro-detail only on the focal character

No texture reinterpretation
🔥 EMOTION

Inevitable transformation

From instinct → awareness → dominance

The final character feels like the destination of a journey
🚫 NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS

No random poses

No redesign

No symmetry

No flat lighting

No full-body sharpness everywhere

No equal importance across all stages
Aspect Ratio: ar 16:9
```

## 390. 3x3 Grid Prompt for Lighting Cheatsheet

- **id**：12645
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=12645

### 描述

A complex prompt for Nano Banana Pro designed to generate a 3x3 grid image containing nine identical portraits of a subject, with each panel demonstrating a different, specifically named lighting technique (e.g., Loop, Split, Butterfly, Golden Hour), useful as a relighting cheatsheet.

### 示例图

![3x3 Grid Prompt for Lighting Cheatsheet](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1774248307158_jyis07_HECyRQkbwAAPNRV.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A 3x3 photo grid presented as a single image on a dark grey background. Each of the nine grid cells contains a different portrait of the same subject from the uploaded image, maintaining the perfect character consistency, outfit and pose across all panels. Below each individual portrait, a clean sans-serif text label with a number and name is clearly displayed.

The grid layout and lighting setups are: 

- Top row, left to right:

Loop Lighting (Flattering 3/4 light with a small loop of shadow from the nose onto the cheek)

Hardlight Frontal Flash (direct front facing, harsh flashlight with deep frontal shadows)

Split Lighting (dramatic light on only one side of the face, leaving the other side completely dark)

- Middle row, left to right:

Butterfly Lighting  (classic symmetrical light from the front, slightly high, with a small shadow under the nose)

Gobo Pattern (Venetian Blind)' (light projected through Venetian blinds, creating linear shadows across the face and clothes, the shadow can also be scene on the background)

Under-Lighting (Uplight)' (light coming from below, creating reverse shadows and a moody look)

- Bottom row, left to right:

Golden Hour / Warm Light' (bathed in soft, golden, warm light from a side angle)

Dramatic Spotlight  (hard, narrow circular beam of light, with a deep chiascuro effect and crushed blacks)

Neutral Kelvin Rim Light' (intense backlighting with no front fill, creating a distinct glowing outline around the hair and shoulders, leaving the face in darkness, against a black background).

The perspective and features remain identical in all panels, with only the specified lighting changing to match the label.
```

## 592. Monochrome Kinetic Product Photography Prompt

- **id**：12105
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=12105

### 描述

A detailed prompt for generating a high-end, minimalist beauty editorial image featuring a skincare bottle held by hands, using monochrome color, motion blur effects (ghosting/multi-exposure) to convey kinetic energy, and soft, high-key studio lighting.

### 示例图

![Monochrome Kinetic Product Photography Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1773469798579_4xb2jq_HDQydCnbAAAkRZK.jpg)

### 提示词

```
[WHAT_IT_IS] Commerce/editorial product image. Monochrome studio study of a {argument name="product type" default="skincare bottle"} held between two hands with pronounced multi-frame motion blur for kinetic, airy minimalism. [SUBJECT_SCENE] Two hands occupy the frame on a pale seamless background, positioned diagonally: the upper hand enters from the right holding a small cylindrical pump bottle near the top-left quadrant, while a second hand below reaches upward from the lower-left, fingers open as if about to receive the product. The bottle is angled slightly downward-left, label side facing camera, with a matte body and a reflective metallic pump/collar that catches bright highlights. The hands are rendered with visible multi-exposure ghosting--each hand shows several offset silhouettes trailing along the direction of motion, especially around fingertips, creating a layered flutter effect. The bottle remains comparatively stable and readable, acting as the sharp anchor amid the blur, though its edges show slight softness consistent with motion. Composition is sparse and balanced: large negative space surrounds the central hand/product cluster, and the diagonal hand positions create a gentle "handoff" narrative. Focus is shallow-to-moderate but controlled so the product stays the visual priority while the ghosting conveys movement rather than defocus. [BACKGROUND] Clean pale gray/white seamless with no horizon line, reading as a minimal studio field. [LIGHTING_EFFECTS] Bright, diffused high-key lighting produces smooth tonal gradients on skin and the bottle body, with minimal harsh shadow edges. The metallic pump reflects a tight highlight band, indicating a slightly harder specular component within an otherwise soft setup. Motion effects read as long-exposure or composited frame trails: semi-transparent duplicates of the hands stack with decreasing opacity, creating soft-edged blur that is most intense at the fingertips and less pronounced near the wrists. Shadows are faint and washed, suggesting strong fill and a background pushed toward white; any contact shadowing is reduced to soft gray haze beneath the hands. The overall contrast is moderate, with skin texture subtly visible but simplified by the monochrome treatment and diffusion. No heavy bloom; instead the "airiness" comes from high-key exposure and the layered motion trails. [IMAGE_STYLE] Minimalist, high-end beauty editorial--monochrome palette, negative space, and kinetic motion-blur compositing to imply sensorial application/ritual. Designed to feel premium and modern, translating product handling into an abstract, graphic gesture.
```

```
SCULPTURE MATERIAL
The subject is carved from painted wood or resin (polychrome sculpture style).

Skin is no longer skin:
It becomes a matte carved surface with visible tool marks, tiny cracks, subtle paint wear, and hardened edges.

Add:
• chisel planes on cheeks and forehead
• carved eyelids and nostrils
• slightly flattened planes instead of soft flesh
• painted but slightly aged coloration

HAIR (CRITICAL — THIS DEFINES THE STYLE)
Hair must NOT look real.

The hair is sculpted:
• carved locks and grooves
• thick grouped strands
• simplified shapes
• visible chisel cuts
• rigid structure
• no flyaways, no softness, no realistic strands

Think: artisan statue hair, not human hair.

CLOTHING
Clothing becomes carved fabric:
• simplified folds
• hardened drapery
• painted texture
• slightly worn edges

COMPOSITION
• chest-up bust
• mounted on a round pedestal base
• centered framing
• neutral studio background
• soft museum lighting
• photographed like an art catalog

AVOID
real skin texture
photoreal pores
```

The attire is also fixed: an oversize white t-shirt without a logo or inscription, wide black pants, white sneakers with black stripes (retro style), a belt, a chain, or keys at the waist (unbranded) are acceptable. The legs: one leg is extended, the other slightly bent, the heel raised, creating a model posture. Quality/Style: ultra-realistic, sharp focus on the face, slight depth of field, natural complexion, light grain, no retouching, glossy appearance. ### 描述

A highly technical prompt for generating a hyper-realistic 8K product render. It specifies extreme detail in lighting (hard edge lighting, rim light, chiaroscuro), materials (brushed aluminum, mirror chrome), and composition (centered, levitating in a pure black void), while strictly forbidding common photography elements.

### 示例图

![Hyper-Realistic Product Render with Holochrome Gradients](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1772605586143_0xb7bg_HCfukwtWsAAqFSp.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create a hyper-realistic 8K product render of {argument name="product name" default="[INSERT YOUR PRODUCT HERE]"}

The subject should be perfectly centered and levitating in mid-air, floating in a void with no surface, platform, stand, or floor. Show the full product with zero cropping and visible margins on all sides. 
Use a dynamic macro 45-degree hero angle.

The background must be solid pure black (#000000).

Lighting should feature hard edge lighting with strong rim light highlights. Use a high-contrast chiaroscuro look with thin chromatic aberration along metallic edges. Include reflective caustic light hits and an oily iridescent sheen on polished surfaces.

Color palette:

Background: #000000
Metal highlights: #E0E0E0
Iridescent accents: #4169E1, #FFD700, #FF4500

Materials and textures should combine micro-brushed sandblasted aluminum with mirror-finish chrome. Add subtle prismatic dispersion and thin-film interference along metal curves. Include fine film grain for tactile realism.

Do not include any props or additional objects. 
No light boxes, umbrellas, softboxes, pedestals, cables, tripods, or hands. 
No cropped edges or cut-off parts. 
No text, logos, watermarks, blur, bokeh background, dust, or scratches.

Style reference: Industrial Design meets luxury hardware photography.
```

A detailed prompt for a high-end, retro editorial portrait of a man in a structured double-breasted suit, captured in an Art Deco hall with stained-glass windows. ### 提示词

```
Shot on a Hasselblad 907X 50C with an XCD 90mm f/2.5 lens, aperture f/2.8 shallow depth of field emphasizes the precision fit of the suit while the background dissolves into painterly color patches; captured in 16-bit RAW with high dynamic range and soft film grain to preserve wool texture and the glow of colored light without "harsh" digital sharpness. Frame a tight portrait cropped to mid-chest, at eye level, with a slight three-quarter turn; the model is offset from center so the stained-glass pattern reads in the negative space. The pose is calm and composed: shoulders open, posture confident but without tension; one hand neatly adjusts the tie knot or collar line, the other is in the trouser pocket, slightly opening the jacket and revealing the layered styling. Expression restrained and thoughtful; the gaze passes just past the lens, as if distant music is playing. Outfit a man in a suit with a retro accent: a structured double-breasted wool blazer with sharp lapels, high-waisted pleated trousers, a white shirt and narrow tie, polished Oxfords, and a minimal pocket square. Location a retro Art Deco hall with dark wood, brass, and a tall stained-glass window projecting jewel-like geometry onto the suit and background. Light warm practical fill from one side and colored stained-glass light from the other, cinematic contrast, "stained-glass" shadows. Result -retro editorial: graphic, refined, expensive, and timeless
```

```
Measurements, dimensions, and precise scale markers Material callouts and quantities 
Color-coded arrows for function/flow: RED (power/battery), BLUE (data/connectivity), ORANGE (thermal/processor), GREEN (sensors/haptics)
Simple schematics or cross-sectional diagrams where relevant 
Place “OBJECT NAME” title in a hand-drawn technical box (top-left corner).
Style: Black linework (technical pen/architectural), sketched but precise. Object remains clearly visible. Educational museum-exhibit vibe. Clean composition, balanced negative space.
Perspective: Isometric 3D angle—tilted to show depth, dimension, and internal architecture dramatically. Like a professional product teardown or engineering manual.
Colors: ~10–15% accent density. Black dominant. White background.
Output: 1080×1080, ultra-crisp, social-feed optimized.
```

## 1196. Collectible Miniature Diorama of a Rugged Mining Settlement

- **id**：10564
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=10564

### 描述

A highly detailed prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a stylized 3D collectible miniature diorama. The scene is a rugged mining settlement built into a jungle-covered volcanic slope, featuring wooden platforms, drilling towers, and tiny workers. The style mandates smooth matte ceramic/resin textures, simplified geometry, and professional studio product lighting, explicitly avoiding photorealistic textures or real-world photography aesthetics.

### 示例图

![Collectible Miniature Diorama of a Rugged Mining Settlement](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1771741700290_rwd8vz_HBtATw3bgAADXCz.jpg)

### 提示词

```
SCENE:
A rugged mining settlement built into a jungle-covered volcanic slope with wooden platforms, drilling towers, and rope lifts. Tiny workers guide carts along narrow tracks while monkeys climb vines and dense foliage surrounds the machinery.

When generating or inventing a scene, prioritize architectural and cultural diversity and intentionally vary the environment type, building styles, historical inspiration, regional influence, and settlement purpose so each generated miniature feels visually distinct and not a repetition of common village, temple, garden, or plaza layouts.
Ensure the architecture organizes around a natural central hub so structures cluster with believable spatial gravity, forming a cohesive miniature settlement with denser core structures and supporting elements arranged outward. Arrange the layout as a compact, layered, interconnected district filling the platform naturally without empty gaps. Ensure the entire environment clearly reads as a small handcrafted tabletop collectible model, with miniature-scale architecture and compressed model-world proportions rather than life-sized buildings.
STYLE:
Frame the camera at a stable product-display distance so the entire collectible diorama remains clearly visible with comfortable margins, avoiding close cinematic crops or environmental perspective shots. Render as a premium stylized 3D collectible miniature diorama on a fully visible, centered self-contained display base, shown from a slightly elevated 3/4 tabletop angle against a clean neutral studio gradient background. Maintain collectible figurine scale and clean display presentation.
All elements should appear sculpted from smooth matte ceramic, painted resin, or stylized polymer with rounded edges, simplified geometry, and slightly exaggerated toy-like proportions. Keep surfaces clean and intentionally stylized. Avoid fingerprints, rough handmade textures, workshop scenes, macro photography depth-of-field, or photoreal clay imperfections.
Use soft professional studio product lighting: gentle global illumination, warm key light, soft ambient bounce, controlled shadows, and optional warm interior window glow.
Render any water or translucent materials as poured clear resin with smooth transparency, subtle reflections, soft internal depth, and slightly thick stylized edges.
Include small environmental details but keep everything cohesive, simplified, and sculptural. Prioritize clean stylized modeling over photorealistic texture detail.
Overall intent: premium collectible miniature, stylized 3D marketplace presentation, cozy whimsical mood, smooth sculpt clarity, controlled studio rendering, avoid real-world photography aesthetics.
aspect ratio 4:3
```

### 描述

A structured, multi-phase prompt template designed to generate a minimalist, 2D vector illustration of a vintage-style storefront for a specific brand. It uses a toggle system to include or exclude subjects, dynamically generates a 'Club' or 'Community' title, and enforces a 1950s-60s retro line art style with a two-tone color palette.

```
[BRAND NAME] | [SUBJECT_TOGGLE]. Act as a Lead Graphic Designer.

PHASE 1: ARCHITECTURAL SETTING.

Create a minimalist 2D vector illustration of a vintage-style storefront representing [BRAND NAME]. 

- Autonomously design the facade (Modernist, Industrial, or Classic) to match the brand's heritage.

PHASE 2: SUBJECT LOGIC (TOGGLE SYSTEM).

- If [SUBJECT_TOGGLE] is "OFF": Show only the empty storefront.

- If [SUBJECT_TOGGLE] is "ON": Autonomously add 1-2 characters or a pet that fits the brand's lifestyle.

PHASE 3: DYNAMIC TYPOGRAPHY (CORRECTED).

- Header: Autonomously generate a high-status "Club" or "Community" title based on the nature of [BRAND NAME]. * Examples: For Starbucks — "Coffee Roasters Society"; for Nike — "Elite Runners Club"; for Apple — "Digital Creators Guild". 

- Branding: Place the [BRAND NAME] logo clearly on the storefront awning.

- Contextual Info: Below the awning, add "EST. [REAL FOUNDING YEAR]" and "[REAL ORIGIN CITY]".

PHASE 4: VISUAL STYLE.

- Two-tone palette: [BRAND SIGNATURE COLOR] on a pure white background.

- Style: 1950s-60s Retro Line Art. No gradients, no shadows.

TECH SPECS:

Flat 2D vector, 8k resolution, monochrome aesthetic, centered composition.
```

```
Task: Ultra-close macro hero shot of a {argument name="subject" default="SUBJECT"} as premium optical cast glass with diagonal light-band shadows, stronger rainbow caustics, and clean readable high-detail areas (no refraction “mush”). Subject is FULLY visible and NOT cropped. The subject is placed on the surface or floating in the air at a low altitude above the surface.
Style: Photoreal luxury product; seamless blue-gray gradient background #9FAFBC (cool, slightly blue, low saturation); glossy reflective plane; smooth clear optical glass with crisp edges, controlled internal highlights, subtle star glints; pronounced caustic streaks + vivid prismatic rainbow arcs cast onto the surface from the subject.
Framing: extreme close-up, subject fills ~90–95% of the frame, fully visible and not cropped.

Optical control: low-distortion, low-aberration glass look (reduced dispersion inside the object) with strong external caustics on the surface.
Lighting: broad diagonal soft light bands; long soft cast shadow with smooth penumbra; rainbow caustics should be stronger and more numerous around the base and across the floor. Clean white color.
Environment control: seamless studio only; gray/black flags controlling reflections; no window/room elements.
Negative prompt: excessive refraction, heavy distortion, lens effect, warped facial features, chaotic highlights, milky/foggy glass, random reflections, window, interior, wall corner, faceted, polygonal, low poly, text, watermark, clutter
```

## 1476. Cinematic Gourmet Burger Explosion Prompt (Code Style)

- **id**：10020
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=10020

### 描述

A highly structured, code-like prompt using Python syntax (importing physics and lighting modules) to generate a cinematic advertising image of a gourmet burger exploding in slow motion, detailing ingredients, textures, and studio lighting setup.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Gourmet Burger Explosion Prompt (Code Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1771050461758_fxcwxn_HBAYMJybsAEscTG.jpg)

![Cinematic Gourmet Burger Explosion Prompt (Code Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1771050461797_riopi6_HBAYMIDbsAEnmLk.jpg)

### 提示词

```
import physics_engine as cinematic
from studio_lighting import RimLight, SpotLight

class GourmetBurger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.state = "assembled"
        self.ingredients = [
            "toasted_brioche_bun", 
            "wagyu_patty", 
            "molten_cheddar", 
            "crispy_lettuce", 
            "heirloom_tomato",
            "secret_sauce_droplets"
        ]

    def trigger_explosion(self):
        """
        Executes the slow-motion deconstruction effect.
        """
        self.state = "mid-air_burst"
        
        for item in self.ingredients:
            # Applying physics for the "flying" effect
            item.apply_force(direction="outward", velocity="slow_motion")
            item.render_texture(quality="hyper_detailed")
            
        # Suspends liquid particles in 3D space
        cinematic.suspend_fluids(type="sauce", density="high_viscosity")

# Environment Configuration
scene = cinematic.Scene(background="dark_studio_charcoal")
scene.add_lighting([
    RimLight(intensity=0.8, color="warm_gold"),
    SpotLight(target="patty_texture", focus="ultra_sharp")
])

# Execute the render
burger = GourmetBurger()
burger.trigger_explosion()

render_output = scene.capture(style="cinematic_advertising", realistic=True)
```

## 1695. Triptych Composition Prompt for Abstract Fashion Editorial

- **id**：9471
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=9471

### 描述

A complex, multi-panel prompt designed to generate a vertical triptych (three stacked images) of the same high-gloss, sculpted subject. The prompt dictates escalating intimacy and intensity through extreme close-up camera techniques (low angle, macro, canted angle, selective blur) to create a dynamic, abstract fashion editorial look without relying on environment or props.

### 示例图

![Triptych Composition Prompt for Abstract Fashion Editorial](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770619708000_wd22mq_HAoLvZvawAA-v1y.jpg)

### 提示词

```
THE TASK
Act as a world-class fashion photographer shooting a defining editorial campaign. Create a cohesive 3-panel vertical triptych (stacked top, middle, bottom) of the same subject. The sequence escalates intimacy and intensity through extreme proximity, revealing tactile hyper-realism and restrained dynamic power purely via photographic technique — no environmental changes, no added elements.
TRIPTYCH COMPOSITION
(VERTICAL STACK – ESCALATING CLOSE-UP INTENSITY)
Top Panel – Presence (Intense Dominant Close-Up)
Dynamic low 3/4 angle close-up (camera below the main form, tilted upward) to create looming, commanding scale.
Tight crop: the subject’s primary focal feature and sharp contours dominate; one side falls into deep shadow.
Subtle implied motion via slight rotational tilt and micro-blur only on far-edge highlights — keep the central zone razor-sharp.
Specular streaks rake across glossy surfaces like wet lacquer, emphasizing curvature and fine material imperfections.
Background: pure high-key white with faint gradient falloff — identical across all panels, no environmental cues.
Middle Panel – Control (Kinetic Structural Sweep)
Canted-angle macro from the side with aggressive perspective distortion.
Crop frames the central structural zone, with key elements off-center and partially cut by frame edges.
Highlights slice diagonally across contoured channels and ridges due to the dramatic angle.
Very shallow depth of field: nearest surface tack-sharp, farther planes melt softly to suggest velocity and tension.
Same pure high-key white background and exact tonal range — variation achieved solely through camera angle and lens proximity.
Bottom Panel – Essence (Extreme Graphic Detail)
Extreme macro from an aggressive angle evoking a controlled whip-pan. Choose one signature detail and make it feel alive with implied motion while remaining graphically pristine:

A protruding or extending element shot from below, strongly foreshortened, reaching toward the lens,
Or a central geometric/functional feature shot on a steep diagonal, highlights spiraling like motion trails,
Or a sharp edge or blade-like contour shot from behind, catching a razor-thin specular line.

Apply controlled directional blur only to a secondary trailing plane; keep the primary micro-texture impeccably crisp.
Frame so tight it becomes near-abstract: beveled edges, micro-scratches, gloss pooling, subtle material stress marks, fine imperfections.
No debris, no additional elements — identical high-key white background maintained.
STYLING & BOLD CHOICES (CRITICAL)
Subject: {argument name="subject material" default="any high-gloss, sculpted form with precise contours and reflective surfaces"}.
No additional objects, characters, props, text, or logos.
All sense of energy and motion derived exclusively from camera technique: low/canted angles, foreshortening, shallow depth of field, controlled selective blur, and highlight flow.
Identical lighting rig across all three panels — consistent
```

### 描述

A prompt for generating a dramatic, high-fashion cinematic portrait of a woman (Sadie Sink likeness) wearing a black velvet gown. The key feature is the use of monochromatic deep red studio lighting and a 'shutter drag' or long-exposure effect to create an ethereal motion blur trailing behind the subject's face.

### 示例图

![High-Fashion Cinematic Portrait with Shutter Drag Effect](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1770273435289_xg6dtq_HAUc8wpWUAE_oiU.jpg)

### 提示词

```
"A high-fashion cinematic portrait of a woman with wavy auburn hair, wearing a deep-V neck black velvet gown. The scene is drenched in a monochromatic {argument name="lighting color" default="deep red"} studio light. A 'shutter drag' or long-exposure effect creates a ghostly, ethereal motion blur trailing to the right of her face. She has a poised, high-glance expression with bold red lipstick. One hand is gracefully touching her neck, showing a statement ring. Moody, dramatic shadows, 8k resolution, shot on 35mm lens, fashion editorial style."
>
Breakdown of Details
| Element | Description |
|---|---|
| Lighting | Saturated red monochromatic lighting with high contrast (Chiaroscuro effect). |
| Technical Effect | Shutter Drag / Motion Blur: The "ghosting" effect behind the head suggests movement during a slow exposure. |
| Subject | A woman with fair skin, freckles, and wavy {argument name="hair color" default="ginger/auburn"} hair. |
| Wardrobe | A minimalist, elegant black dress with a plunging neckline that contrasts sharply against the red background. |
| Composition | Medium shot, centered, with a soft-focus vignette that draws attention to the face and hands. |
Tips for Customizing
 * To change the mood: Replace "deep red" with "electric blue" or "neon emerald" for a different vibe.
 * To change the model: You can specify "shorter hair," "different ethnicity," or "alternative clothing" while keeping the "motion blur" and "monochromatic light" tags to maintain the style.

```
```
IMAGE: Frame & Composition: The camera presents a straight-on, eye-level product still life with a frontal viewing angle, where two cylindrical objects are positioned side by side and occupy the central vertical axis of the frame; the composition is tightly cropped horizontally with minimal negative space on either side, and vertically cropped just above the top edges of the glass and container and just below the supporting base; visual weight is balanced evenly between the transparent glass on the left and the opaque container on the right, with both resting squarely on a rectangular block that anchors the composition at the bottom edge. Lighting & Atmosphere: A soft, directional key light enters from the upper left, producing crisp but controlled specular highlights on the glass surface and subtle shadow gradients along the cylindrical container; shadows are soft-edged and fall slightly to the right and downward, indicating a large diffused light source; micro-specular highlights on water droplets suggest a clean, dry studio environment with no haze, bloom, or atmospheric diffusion, resulting in high micro-contrast and clarity. Subject Geometry & Materiality: The left object is a vertically oriented transparent cylinder filled with liquid and suspended citrus slices, aligned perpendicular to the base; condensation droplets of varying diameter adhere to the outer surface, creating localized magnification and distortion of the contents; the right object is a matte-finish cylindrical deodorant container with a flat top, aligned parallel to the glass; its surface shows fine water droplets with lower reflectivity than the glass due to the satin material; printed typography appears flush with the container surface, with no embossing visible; the base is a rectangular wooden block with vertical grain lines, sharp edges, and a semi-matte finish, oriented square to the camera. Environmental Layering: The foreground consists of the wooden block edge, closest to the lens with crisp edge definition; the midground contains the glass and deodorant container in full focus; the background is a uniform light gray plane with no visible texture or objects, fully out of focus but evenly lit, providing clear separation from the subjects without depth cues. Technical Artifacts & Color: The color palette is restrained and natural, dominated by muted sage green, pale gray, translucent yellow-green, and warm amber-brown wood tones; saturation is moderate with emphasis on freshness cues from the green citrus; contrast is medium-high, especially between the transparent glass highlights and matte container surface; fine digital grain is minimal and uniform; no chromatic aberration, lens distortion, or motion blur is visible, indicating a controlled studio setup with a standard focal length lens. ### 描述
```

A highly structured prompt for Gemini Nano Banana Pro to create a 3x3 commercial grid focusing on Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers. It defines nine unique visual concepts while strictly enforcing product consistency, lighting, and a high-end editorial aesthetic suitable for luxury fashion advertising.

### 示例图

### 提示词

```
Create a 3x3 grid for a high-end commercial marketing campaign, centered around Alexander McQueen men's luxury sneakers.

Each frame should present a unique visual concept while maintaining perfect product consistency across all nine images.

Grid Concepts (one per cell):

1. 'Iconic Hero Shot': Eye-level side view on a dark, glossy pedestal, emphasizing the signature oversized sole.

2. 'Extreme Macro Detail': Close-up of the heel or stitching, highlighting the top-tier leather texture and the 'Alexander McQueen' logo embossing.

3. 'Dynamic Interaction': The shoe stepping onto a surface, creating a subtle and elegant splash effect of black liquid or marble powder.

4. 'Minimalist Sculptural Feel': The shoe artistically balanced on a geometric concrete or marble block, emphasizing the architectural design.

5. 'Floating Lightness': The shoe suspended in the air with dynamic hanging laces, conveying supreme comfort and lightness.

6. 'Sensory Texture': A tactile atmosphere shot focusing on the contrast between the velvet or smooth leather upper and a rough stone texture.

7. 'Monochromatic Luxury': A color-block scene where the background perfectly matches the shoe's accent color, creating a bold editorial look.

8. 'Deconstructed Craftsmanship': An abstract arrangement of raw materials (leather swatches, rubber textures) surrounding the shoe, symbolizing high-quality construction.

9. 'Surreal Fusion': The shoe integrated into a surreal, dreamlike landscape, blending realism with high fashion.

Visual Rules:
* 'Subject': Alexander McQueen men's oversized sneakers.
* 'Consistency': The shoe's shape, proportion, sole thickness, logo placement, and typography must be 100% accurate.
* 'No Distortion': No deformation of the signature sole or branding.
* 'Separation': Clear separation between the shoe and the background.

Lighting and Style:
* Soft, controlled studio lighting with dramatic rim light to highlight the shoe's silhouette.
* Subtle highlights on the leather, deep realistic shadows under the sole.
* High dynamic range, 8K resolution, ultra-sharp focus.
* Editorial luxury fashion advertising aesthetic (Vogue/GQ style).
* Color Palette: Minimalist, monochromatic, metallic, and deep matte tones.

Overall Vibe:
* Modern, sophisticated, visually coherent.
* High-end commercial campaign for a luxury fashion brand.
* Surreal, cinematic, refined, and aspirational.
```

### 描述

A prompt designed to generate illustrations suitable for creating resin charms, focusing on isolating the main subject and handling backgrounds based on whether a reference image is provided with or without a background.

### 示例图

![Resin Charm Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769408664507_cunurs_G_d7YCna8AACduk.jpg)

![Resin Charm Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769408664414_y4g2wy_G_d7XbzXgAAYtBx.jpg)

![Resin Charm Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769408664495_rz4ry2_G_d7ZFWaIAABcgT.jpg)

![Resin Charm Illustration Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769408666307_e23666_G_d7ZqoaAAAI34O.jpg)

### 提示词

```
You are a professional illustrator. Based on the image attached by the user, please generate an illustration that can be used as material for a resin charm.

**Illustration Requirements:**
1.  **Emphasis on Subject:** Extract the main subject (character, animal, object, etc.) from the attached image and draw it to maximize its appeal.
2.  **Background Processing:**
    *   If the attached image has no background (transparent or solid color), automatically add a simple and cute background that matches the subject's atmosphere (e.g., pale gradient, small star or heart patterns, watercolor-style bleed).
    *   If the attached image has a background, use that background as is and integrate it into the illustration.
3.  **Style:** Draw in a cute, deformed illustration style with vibrant, clear colors and distinct outlines. Be mindful of gloss and three-dimensionality so that it looks good when enclosed in resin.
4.  **Output Format:** Output as a square image.

**Notes:**
*   Do not run in High-Speed mode; always run in PRO mode or Thinking mode.
*   The generated illustration is intended to be used as material for a resin charm.
```

## 2552. Structured Figure/Diorama Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro

- **id**：7511
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7511

### 描述

A highly structured, programmer-like prompt designed for Nano Banana Pro to generate images of figures or dioramas. It uses global variable concepts and allows customization across multiple dimensions: composition, environment, aspect ratio, display base, information density, figure material, and lighting style. The goal was to create a single prompt capable of generating various styles, from simple figures to complex dioramas.

### 示例图

![Structured Figure/Diorama Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322338518_qaabl2_G_acR4NawAA2HMq.jpg)

![Structured Figure/Diorama Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322338623_3me96r_G_acR4gboAAt_GM.jpg)

![Structured Figure/Diorama Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322338779_n67azf_G_acR4tXsAAhROb.jpg)

![Structured Figure/Diorama Generation Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769322340439_pajl0d_G_acR43W8AAx_49.jpg)

### 提示词

```
■ COMPOSITION_MODE: Composition and Angle
Faithful Framing: Maintains the zoom ratio and composition of the original illustration 'as is'.
Full-Body: Even if the original image is only upper body, it completes the feet to render a 'full-body figure'.
High-Angle View: Forcibly switches to a 45-degree high-angle 'overhead (bird's-eye) view'.

■ ENVIRONMENT_TYPE: Background Construction
Auto: AI analyzes the original image and automatically selects 'Diorama' if there is a detailed background, or 'Studio Background' if it is simple.
Force Diorama: Even if the original image has a white background, it forcibly constructs an elaborate miniature set (cityscape, nature, interior, etc.).
Force Studio: Eliminates any background and replaces it with a clean photographic backdrop or acrylic sheet.

■ ASPECT_RATIO: Screen Ratio
Inherit: Same ratio as the original image.
Square: 1:1. For SNS posts or icon-style compositions.
Portrait: 9:16. For smartphone wallpapers or dynamically showing standing figures.
Landscape: 16:9. For showcasing wide diorama sets.

■ DISPLAY_BASE: Base Selection
Simple Round: Transparent or opaque circular plastic base. Results in the most common figure appearance.
Decorative: Custom base with decorations matching the character's theme (rubble, magic circles, luxurious designs, etc.).
Diorama Floor: Eliminates the concept of a base, placing the figure directly on the diorama ground.
None: Excludes both the base and ground details, resulting in the simplest self-standing state.

■ DENSITY: Information Density
Standard: A clean, organized finish, like a catalog photo.
High: Adds a large number of small objects (model grass, rubble, miniature furniture, etc.) within the diorama to maximize information density.

■ FIGURE_MATERIAL: Figure Material Texture
Standard PVC: Standard plastic feel of commercial figures. Softly diffuses light.
Premium Resin: Detailed molding and a high-grade resin feel with slight transparency. Texture like a garage kit.
Glossy Plastic: A texture with strong reflections, like a glossy painted finish.

■ LIGHTING_STYLE: Lighting
Natural: Soft natural light, like being photographed by a window. Everyday atmosphere.
Bright Studio: Advertising photo style with multiple lights, minimal shadows, and clear details.
Cinematic: Strong contrast and shadows to create a profound atmosphere, like a scene from a story.
```

```
{ "scene\_type": "nightlife\_lifestyle", "setting": { "location": "outdoor restaurant or lounge patio", "time": "night", "environment": "urban, intimate, upscale", "lighting": "warm ambient lighting from patio heaters and string lights" }, "composition": { "format": "four-image collage", "layout": "2x2 grid", "continuity": "same subject, outfit, and location across all frames" }, "subject": { "type": "person in the reference image", "appearance": { "hair": { "color": "blonde", "length": "long", "style": "loose, softly waved" } }, "clothing": { "outerwear": "black leather jacket", "top": "black cut-out crop top", "bottom": "black fitted mini skirt" }, "expressions": [ "confident", "relaxed", "contemplative", "posed" ], "poses": [ "standing with wine glass", "seated holding wine glass", "leaning with hands near waist", "resting chin on hand" ] }, "objects": [ { "type": "wine\_glass", "content": "{argument name="drink color" default="red wine"}", "held": true }, { "type": "patio\_heater", "description": "tall outdoor gas heater emitting warm light" }, { "type": "met"

Style the subject in a full black nightlife outfit. A black leather jacket paired with a black cut-out crop top and a fitted black mini skirt works perfectly for a confident and modern look. The hair should be long, blonde, loose, and softly waved to maintain an effortless nightlife vibe.

Across the four frames, vary the subject’s expressions and poses. One image can show the subject standing confidently while holding a glass of red wine. Another can be seated and relaxed with the wine glass in hand. A third pose can involve leaning slightly with hands near the waist for a composed look. The final frame can be more contemplative, with the subject resting their chin on their hand.
```

## 2663. 9-Panel Product Storyboard Mockup Prompt

- **id**：7189
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7189

### 描述

A highly structured prompt designed to generate a 3x3 storyboard grid for a high-end product branding portfolio. It mandates using a reference image for product consistency across all nine panels and specifies unique composition, focus, and setting for each frame, emphasizing form, composition, and visual rhythm over realism.

### 示例图

![9-Panel Product Storyboard Mockup Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769149364094_5vjm3w_G_Qh_LCbwAAIvTE.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A clean 3×3 [ratio] storyboard grid with nine equal [ratio] sized panels on [4:5] ratio. 

Use the reference image as the base product reference. Keep the same product, packaging design, branding, materials, colors, proportions and overall identity across all nine panels exactly as the reference. The product must remain clearly recognizable in every frame. The label, logo and proportions must stay exactly the same.

This storyboard is a high-end designer mockup presentation for a branding portfolio. The focus is on form, composition, materiality and visual rhythm rather than realism or lifestyle narrative. The overall look should feel curated, editorial and design-driven.

FRAME 1:
Front-facing hero shot of the product in a clean studio setup. Neutral background, balanced composition, calm and confident presentation of the product.

FRAME 2:
Close-up shot with the focus centered on the middle of the product. Focusing on surface texture, materials and print details.

FRAME 3:
Shows the reference product placed in an environment that naturally fits the brand and product category. Studio setting inspired by the product design elements and colours. 

FRAME 4:
Product shown in use or interaction on a neutral studio background. Hands and interaction elements are minimal and restrained, the look matches the style of the package. 

FRAME 5:
Isometric composition showing multiple products arranged in a precise geometric order from the top isometric angle. All products are placed at the same isometric top angle, evenly spaced, clean, structured and graphic.

FRAME 6:
Product levitating slightly tilted on a neutral background that matches the reference image color palette. Floating position is angled and intentional, the product is floating naturally in space.

FRAME 7:
is an extreme close-up focusing on a specific detail of the label, edge, texture or material behavior.

FRAME 8:
The product in an unexpected yet aesthetically strong setting that feels bold, editorial and visually striking.
Unexpected but highly stylized setting. Studio-based, and designer-driven. Bold composition that elevates the brand.

FRAME 9:
Wide composition showing the product in use, placed within a refined designer setup. Clean props, controlled styling, cohesive with the rest of the series.

CAMERA & STYLE:
Ultra high-quality studio imagery with a real camera look. Different camera angles and framings across frames. Controlled depth of field, precise lighting, accurate materials and reflections. Lighting logic, color palette, mood and visual language must remain consistent across all nine panels as one cohesive series.

OUTPUT:
A clean 3×3 grid with no borders, no text, no captions and no watermarks.
```

```
PHOTO TYPE / MOOD

Ultra-realistic editorial street-style fashion photograph, quiet luxury mood, cinematic but clean, minimal emotion, confident and composed.

One stylish woman (mid-20s to early-30s), slim build, medium skin tone, hair in a tight sleek bun, wearing narrow black cat-eye sunglasses. Neutral expression, lips closed, looking back toward camera over her left shoulder.

WARDROBE / STYLING

All-black outfit: oversized structured blazer/jacket draped straight, long wide-leg trousers with soft folds pooling slightly at the shoes, black pointed-toe heels. Minimal visible jewelry. No logos on clothing. Sunglasses are glossy black, sharp angular silhouette.

POSE / BODY LANGUAGE 

Full body, standing on stone steps. Body angled to the right (walking direction), left shoulder slightly back. Head turned back toward camera. One hand relaxed near the side seam/pocket area (subtle), posture upright, calm, unhurried. Coat/blazer hangs open and straight with slight movement at hem.

LOCATION / BACKGROUND

Neoclassical building entrance façade. Large grey double doors centered behind her with decorative panels and small window-like insets. Tall white fluted columns and ornate trim around the doorway. Stone staircase and landing. Two large square planters (light stone/white) on both sides of the steps with dark green round shrubs. Additional bushy greenery on the right edge. Architectural wall details and a small mounted utility box on the upper right wall.

FRAMING / COMPOSITION

Vertical 4:5 portrait (1080×1350 look). Subject placed slightly left of center on the steps, full figure visible from head to feet. Background symmetrical doorway/columns, but subject breaks symmetry. Foreground includes the stone landing and step edges; right side has a darker shadowed area and greenery. No extra people, no vehicles.

LIGHTING

Warm late-afternoon sunlight coming from camera-right, creating strong directional light and long soft-edged shadows across the steps and façade. Highlights on the right side of her face and jacket edges; left side falls into gentle shadow. Overall contrast medium-high, sunlit cream stone + cooler grey door.

CAMERA / LENS

Full-frame look, 85mm perspective, eye-level to slightly low (but not dramatic), moderate depth of field (backgro
```

## 2729. High-Impact Product Explosion Video Prompt

- **id**：7112
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=7112

### 描述

A detailed, two-scene prompt for generating a high-impact product explosion video featuring a red guava soda can against a red studio background. Scene 1 demands absolute stillness, followed instantly by Scene 2, which requires a violent, aggressive burst of guava liquid and fruit, emphasizing ultra-realistic physics and explosive motion without cinematic softness.

### 示例图

![High-Impact Product Explosion Video Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1769063212406_56yj47_G_KI828aoAMIal5.jpg)

### 提示词

```
A high-impact product explosion video featuring a red guava soda can centered in frame against a solid red studio background.

SCENE 1 — STILLNESS (0–3 seconds):
The soda can stands perfectly upright and completely still at the center of the frame. No liquid, no fruit, no motion. The can appears sealed, intact, and realistic with light condensation droplets. The background is clean and uniform red. Lighting is steady and neutral. No particles, no splashes, no anticipation effects. Absolute stillness is maintained for a full 3 seconds.

SCENE 2 — IMPACT BURST (instant after 3 seconds):
A violent guava splash erupts from behind the can at extreme speed. The splash is aggressive, sudden, and forceful — not cinematic, not slow motion. Thick red guava liquid explodes forward and upward, slamming into the back of the can and visibly shaking it.

Whole guavas, guava slices, and green leaves are launched outward with raw momentum, bursting through the empty space around the can. Liquid sheets tear through the air, creating sharp splashes, chaotic arcs, and dense droplets. The motion is fast, loud, and explosive.

The can remains mostly upright but reacts physically — shaking, vibrating, and slightly shifting from the impact. Fruit pieces and liquid fragments fill the frame by falling, colliding, and splashing around the can, occupying all previously empty space.

No elegance, no slow motion, no cinematic pacing. The burst feels uncontrolled, pressurized, and powerful. Lighting intensifies during the impact to emphasize liquid thickness, fruit texture, and high-speed motion. Final frames show suspended droplets, falling fruit, and liquid wrapping around the can in chaotic aftermath.

Ultra-realistic physics, extreme speed, aggressive energy, commercial-grade realism, bold contrast, explosive motion — no cinematic softness.
```

## 2818. 9-Panel Product Storyboard Grid Prompt

- **id**：6842
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6842

### 描述

A detailed prompt for creating a 3x3 storyboard grid (nine equal panels) from a single reference image. The goal is a high-end designer mockup presentation, focusing on form, composition, and materiality, with each panel showing the product from a different angle, context, or close-up, while maintaining absolute product consistency across all frames.

### 示例图

![9-Panel Product Storyboard Grid Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768977285349_fcvu8y_G_FaISRWkAAHtDT.jpg)

![9-Panel Product Storyboard Grid Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768977285425_h649sn_G_FaISSXMAArcKp.jpg)

![9-Panel Product Storyboard Grid Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768977285329_hv6b53_G_FaISSXUAApmZI.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Create ONE final image.

A clean 3×3 [ratio] storyboard grid with nine equal [ratio] sized panels on [4:5] ratio.

Use the reference image as the base product reference. Keep the same product, packaging design, branding, materials, colors, proportions and overall identity across all nine panels exactly as the reference. The product must remain clearly recognizable in every frame. The label, logo and proportions must stay exactly the same.

This storyboard is a high-end designer mockup presentation for a branding portfolio. The focus is on form, composition, materiality and visual rhythm rather than realism or lifestyle narrative. The overall look should feel curated, editorial and design-driven.

FRAME 1:
Front-facing hero shot of the product in a clean studio setup. Neutral background, balanced composition, calm and confident presentation of the product.

FRAME 2:
Close-up shot with the focus centered on the middle of the product. Focusing on surface texture, materials and print details.

FRAME 3:
Shows the reference product placed in an environment that naturally fits the brand and product category. Studio setting inspired by the product design elements and colours.

FRAME 4:
Product shown in use or interaction on a neutral studio background. Hands and interaction elements are minimal and restrained, the look matches the style of the package.

FRAME 5:
Isometric composition showing multiple products arranged in a precise geometric order from the top isometric angle. All products are placed at the same isometric top angle, evenly spaced, clean, structured and graphic.

FRAME 6:
Product levitating slightly tilted on a neutral background that matches the reference image color palette. Floating position is angled and intentional, the product is floating naturally in space.

FRAME 7:
is an extreme close-up focusing on a specific detail of the label, edge, texture or material behavior.

FRAME 8:
The product in an unexpected yet aesthetically strong setting that feels bold, editorial and visually striking.
Unexpected but highly stylized setting. Studio-based, and designer-driven. Bold composition that elevates the brand.

FRAME 9:
Wide composition showing the product in use, placed within a refined designer setup. Clean props, controlled styling, cohesive with the rest of the series.

CAMERA & STYLE:
Ultra high-quality studio imagery with a real camera look. Different camera angles and framings across frames. Controlled depth of field, precise lighting, accurate materials and reflections. Lighting logic, color palette, mood and visual language must remain consistent across all nine panels as one cohesive series.

OUTPUT:
A clean 3×3 grid with no borders, no text, no captions and no watermarks.
```

- **id**：6819

### 描述

An extremely long and detailed Nano Banana Pro prompt for generating a high-fashion editorial image in a Chinese national style (Guofeng), inspired by actress Zhao Lusi and set in the ancient architecture of Chengdu. The prompt meticulously defines the subject's required facial features (100% strict adherence to reference image), styling (vermilion red dress, gold accessories, autumn ginkgo theme), and cinematic technical parameters (Kodak Portra 400 grain, f/1.4-f/2.0 shallow depth of field, warm amber lighting). It uses the 'framed view' (框景) aesthetic common in Chinese art and references photographers like Paolo Roversi and director Wong Kar-wai.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720533_b8wge3_G-_UqlAXgAEh-tS.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720527_n15mke_G-_Ust-XwAAcyxU.jpg)

![Cinematic Chinese Style Fashion Editorial Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768890720850_6x7njj_G-_Urq7XwAADV8Y.jpg)

### 提示词

```
As a world-class fashion photographer (Steven Meisel / Paolo Roversi / Harley Weir style), shoot a brand-defining autumn Guofeng (Chinese style) fashion editorial for the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand, using **[Reference Image 1 to 100% strictly restore the facial features, hairstyle, and temperament of the person]**. The film focuses on cinematic close-ups and textural details, integrating Eastern framed view aesthetics with contemporary avant-garde fashion language.

[Core Character Restoration]
Strictly refer to Reference Image 1:

Facial Features: 100% restoration of facial proportions, eye shape, nose shape, lip shape, and facial contours.
Hairstyle: Reddish-brown large wavy curls (fluffy and soft texture, fitting the warm autumn tone).
Temperament: Gentle, relaxed, and languid Oriental female elegance.

But allow the following artistic adjustments:

Makeup can be more cinematic (retaining natural base makeup, enhancing dramatic eye expression).
Hair dynamics can show natural flow due to the autumn wind.
Emotional expression can increase cinematic narrative tension based on "gentle gaze."

[Deep Analysis of Brand DNA - Reference Image 2]
Interpretation of the "SHANG CHENG SHI" brand prototype:

Cultural Gene: Collision of Eastern classical aesthetics and contemporary fashion refinement.
Aesthetic Core: The passionate romance of vermilion red + the gentle poetry of golden ginkgo + the Eastern narrative of red wall framed views.
Target Audience Lifestyle: Urban women pursuing "relaxed elegance," loving the Guofeng atmosphere and refined dressing, aspiring to a life aesthetic that "reveals a contemporary attitude within a classical context."

Brand Visual Language:

High-saturation vermilion red as an emotional anchor.
Autumn ginkgo as a seasonal symbolic system.
Vintage gold jewelry as a carrier of refinement.
Red wall framed view as Eastern compositional philosophy.

[Narrative and Composition - Cinematic Multi-Lens Language]
First Group: Intense Portrait Close-up (Cinematic Facial Narrative)
Shot A - Eye Close-up:
Extremely close focus on the eyes and upper face. The gaze penetrates the lens, conveying the "gentle yet firm" power of the Oriental woman. Emphasize:

Golden ginkgo light and shadow reflected in the pupils.
Detailed texture of individual eyelashes.
Natural tension of subtle expression muscles around the eyes.
Blurred halo of vintage gold necklace on the neck.

Shot B - Side Profile Close-up:
45-degree side angle, capturing the perfect contour line from the forehead → nose bridge → lips → jawline. Reddish-brown curls fall behind the ear, and some strands are outlined with a golden edge by the autumn backlight. The background is a blurred collision of vermilion red walls and golden ginkgo colors.
Second Group: Body Language and Emotional Posture (Cinematic Narrative Composition)
Shot C - Full View of Chin-Resting Gaze:
[Core replication shot of Reference Image 2]
The person sits on the red wall window sill, resting their chin, curled up sideways, with soft and relaxed body lines. But add cinematic texture:

The draping folds of the vermilion red fitted dress show a delicate velvet-like texture in the light and shadow.
Gold bracelets form exquisite light spots on the wrist.
Falling ginkgo leaves create natural foreground occlusion (increasing depth of field layers).
Within the red wall frame, the golden ginkgo tree is rendered with soft focus, creating the Oriental aesthetic of a "picture within a picture."

Shot D - Hand Detail Close-up:
Tight crop: Slender fingers lightly touch the cheek, vintage gold bracelets stack on the wrist. Focus locked on:

The contrast between the fine texture of the metal chains and the warm texture of the skin.
The warp and weft details of the vermilion red cuff fabric.
The natural luster of the nails.
The background is blurred into abstract color blocks of vermilion red and gold.

Third Group: Environmental Atmosphere and Oriental Framed View (Cinematic Scene Narrative)
Shot E - Red Wall Framed Medium Shot:
Using the red wall window frame as a natural frame, the person is centered within the frame. The composition follows the Eastern "framed view into painting" philosophy, but the lighting treatment has the chiaroscuro contrast of European cinema:

The illuminated side of the red wall shows a rough, grainy texture.
The edge of the window frame forms a sharp dividing line between light and dark.
The person is softly illuminated by diffused light (from the ginkgo reflection).
The ancient ginkgo architecture in the background forms an abstract golden-yellow atmosphere outside the depth of field.

Shot F - Dynamic of Falling Ginkgo Leaves:
Capturing the moment ginkgo leaves fall in the air. Foreground leaves are sharp, the mid-ground half-body portrait is sharply focused, and the background red wall and ginkgo tree are completely blurred. Conveys "autumn flow" and "poetic time."

[Styling and Avant-Garde Aesthetics (Key Breakthrough Points)]
Clothing:

Main Body: Vermilion red fitted long dress (draping velvet or thick cotton/linen texture, fitted but not overtly sexy, conveying the "elegant restraint" of Eastern aesthetics).
Avant-garde Elements: Can add asymmetrical cuts or architectural structural lines to the cuffs and neckline, breaking the established impression of traditional Qipao.

Accessories:

Vintage Gold Jewelry: Multi-layered necklaces + stacked bracelets, the metallic luster shows a "bygone era" texture in the warm autumn light.
Unexpected Element: Can add a light sheer shawl (translucent texture) floating in the autumn wind, increasing dynamic movement and layering in the image.

Props:

Falling ginkgo leaves (can hold one, increasing interaction).
Ancient red wall window sill used as a natural seat.

This photo must feel: Original (natural relaxed feeling, not posed), Expensive (texture of high-quality fabric and gold jewelry), Deeply Tactile (the viewer can "feel" the autumn breeze and velvet texture).

[Technical Aesthetics - Cinematic Photography Parameters]
Ultra-realistic Texture:

Film Grain: Medium grain (simulating Kodak Portra 400 film), adding a sense of "time" and "warmth."
Texture Detail: Highly restore pores, hair strands, fabric warp and weft, metal scratches, and the rough surface of the red wall.
Depth of Field Control: Large aperture (f/1.4-f/2.0) to create creamy bokeh, highlighting the subject while retaining the environmental atmosphere.

Lighting - Cinematic Treatment of Autumn Natural Light:

Main Light Source: Softly diffused autumn afternoon sunlight (color temperature 3500K-4000K warm tone).
Auxiliary Light: Golden diffuse reflection from ginkgo leaves (creating soft fill light on the face).
Outline Light: Backlight outlining hair strands and body edges with a golden halo.
Shadow Treatment: Retain soft shadows (not extreme chiaroscuro contrast), maintaining the "reserved blank space" of Eastern aesthetics.

Color - Refined Editing Palette:

Main Tones: High-saturation vermilion red (#C8102E) + warm golden yellow (#F4C430).
Auxiliary Colors: Ancient architecture gray-white (#E8E8E8) + reddish-brown hair color (#8B4513).
Atmospheric Color: Warm orange-yellow ambient light (simulating the "golden hour" before autumn dusk).
Color Relationship: "Passionate collision" of red and yellow + "calm balance" of gray-white = core of "Guofeng atmosphere."

Photography Style Reference:

Paolo Roversi's soft-focus portrait texture (soft yet rich in detail).
Wong Kar-wai's film color saturation and nostalgic atmosphere.
Chinese traditional Gongbi painting's "framed composition" and "philosophy of blank space."

[Final Output Requirements]

Character Appearance: 100% restoration of facial features, hairstyle, and temperament from Reference Image 1 (hairstyle can be slightly dynamic, makeup can be cinematic, but facial contours must be absolutely precise).
Style Atmosphere: 80% reference to Reference Image 2's "Autumn Guofeng atmosphere" (red walls, ginkgo, vermilion dress, chin-resting pose) + 20% world-class fashion photography's "cinematic texture and avant-garde styling."
Technical Standards:

4K/8K ultra-high definition quality.
Cinematic color grading (warm autumn color temperature).
Medium film grain.
Precise depth of field control (sharp subject, soft focus background).

Brand Exposure: Retain the "{argument name="Brand Name" default="SHANG CHENG SHI"}" brand logo at the top of the image (elegant modern font, not distracting from the main subject).
Final Tone: This is not an ordinary fashion editorial, but a cross-cultural visual work that "can simultaneously exist on the cover of an international fashion magazine and in an Oriental aesthetics art book."
```

```
World-class cinematic Chinese style fashion portrait photography, top master photographer level (Steven Meisel / Paolo Roversi / Harley Weir level), creating a defining image advertisement for the high-end Chinese lifestyle brand "Yu Zhoukan" and the Nanan District image ambassador. Single complete composition. === Character - 100% Strict Restoration of Reference Image 1 Facial Features === Character Positioning:
Nanan District Image Ambassador, modern Oriental woman, representative of urban cultural elites returning home to seek roots. Precise Facial Feature Replication:
[{argument name="facial description" default="Fill in specific facial description from Reference Image 1 here"}] Face Shape: [{argument name="face shape" default="Describe based on Figure 1 - oval/round/square/heart-shaped face"}]
Eyes: [Based on Figure 1 - eye shape/double eyelids/gaze characteristics]
Nose: [Based on Figure 1 - bridge height/nose shape]
Lips: [Based on Figure 1 - lip shape/corner characteristics]
Skin Tone: [Based on Figure 1 - specific skin tone description]
Unique Features: [Based on Figure 1 - any iconic features]

Hair Style - Adapted from Reference Image 2 Style:
Messy high bun, intentionally imperfect and casual, soft strands naturally falling around the cheeks and neck, conveying the relaxed aesthetic of "no need for elaborate refinement after returning home," not over-styled, embracing natural texture and dynamism. Expression:
Eyes gazing towards the camera (or looking towards the distant Huangshan clouds and mist), with relaxed confidence, a subtle mysterious smile hinting at inner peace and cultural rootedness, embodying the narrative of "modern women reconnecting with their ancestral home," the expression is communicative rather than merely posed, a blend of natural relaxation and quiet strength. === Composition - Single Complete Cinematic Frame === Image Composition:
Medium-long shot full-body portrait, cinematic horizontal 16:9 wide composition. Figure Position: Center-right or center-left (following the rule of thirds), occupying 60-75% of the image height.
Perspective: Eye-level or slight low angle (5-10 degree upward angle), creating an elegant and grand feeling.
Depth of Field: Medium depth of field T2.8-T4.0, the main subject is sharp and crisp, the background mountains and clouds are softly blurred but still recognizable in layers.
Negative Space: Ample sky/mountain negative space to create a sense of breathing room and poetry, not cluttered.

Focus Distribution:
Primary Focus: Subject's facial expression and overall posture.
Secondary Focus: Hand movements (holding a pipe) and clothing details (texture of the red top).
Environmental Focus: The ink-wash poetic quality of the Huangshan cloud and mountain background. === Styling - Avant-garde Chinese Contemporary Aesthetic === Clothing (Based on Reference Image 2 Aesthetic):
Main Top: Oversized cinnabar red (#C8402B) loose Chinese style top. Fabric: High-end silk-cotton blend with delicate traditional hidden patterns.
Texture: Visible weave texture, slight sheen, natural wrinkles conveying relaxed luxury.
Cut: Intentionally oversized, flowing sleeves, embodying the "relaxed aesthetic."
Details: Mandarin collar or modern interpretation, traditional frog buttons or contemporary modification.

Bottoms: Cream off-white (#F5F0E8) loose wide-leg pants. Material: High-quality linen or cotton, natural drape.
Cut: Palace style, flowing.
Function: Balances the visual intensity of the red top, grounding the overall look.

Bold Styling Choices (Key Elements - Creating an Art House Atmosphere): Unexpected Accessory: Traditional wooden pipe (not a cigarette) - cultural artifact as a fashion statement.
Zisha teapot + tea tray appearing as editorial props in the scene, not just decoration.
Ancient stone railing covered in moss as a "fashion runway" - nature meets high fashion.
Juxtaposition Aesthetic: Contemporary fashion sensibility × Traditional Chinese lifestyle objects × Native natural environment.

No conventional jewelry - allowing cultural props and the natural scene itself to become accessories. === Shooting Scene - Huangshan Cloud Sea Mountains (Anhui) === Environmental Setting:
Huangshan cloud sea background, layered mountains in Anhui, China emerging from flowing clouds and mist (ink-wash visual aesthetic).
Foreground: Ancient stone railing/platform covered in moss - weathered texture clearly visible.
Pine trees faintly visible in the mist - mysterious depth.
Atmosphere: Ethereal, timeless, connecting past and present.

Spatial Relationship:
The figure sits casually on the ancient stone railing (one leg propped up, one leg hanging down), the body is relaxed, not posed. One hand rests on the stone surface, the other elegantly holds the pipe. The posture conveys the relaxed state of "no need for pretense after returning home." The overall image presents an Oriental aesthetic where the figure and the landscape coexist harmoniously. Depth of Field Layers:
Foreground: Mossy stone railing details visible (slightly blurred).
Midground: Main subject is sharp and crisp.
Background: Huangshan cloud sea mountains are softly blurred, maintaining an ink-wash layered feel. === Posture Design - Core of Relaxation === Overall Posture:
Sitting casually and naturally on the ancient stone railing, not sitting rigidly, the body slightly angled, showing extended lines. Specific Details: One leg propped up (knee bent, foot resting on the railing edge).
Other leg naturally hanging down or slightly bent.
One hand resting on the stone surface (showing intimate contact with the environment).
Other hand elegantly holding the pipe (near the lips or naturally lowered).
Upper body slightly leaning forward or sideways, not stiff.
Head can be slightly tilted or raised, gaze directed towards the camera or the distant mountain view.

Posture Keywords:
Relaxed, extended, casual, comfortable, unposed, integrated with the environment, conveying "homecoming relaxation." === Lighting Design - Cinematic Drama and Natural Diffusion === Main Light Source:
Soft directional diffused light (simulating natural scattering by clouds and mist). Source: Simulating the natural diffusion effect of mountain clouds and mist, no hard shadows.
Texture: Wrapping, soft, showcasing skin texture without roughness.
Color Temperature: Cool neutral 5200K (misty mountain atmosphere).
Intensity: 75% to create subtle three-dimensionality.

Dramatic Fill Light:
Selective edge light coming from the rear or side-rear, penetrating the mist to create separation from the misty background.
Intensity: 30-40% - subtle, not overwhelming.
Effect: Soft halo on the bun, shoulder line, and clothing edges, creating an ethereal texture.
Outlines the figure's silhouette, increasing image depth.

Light and Shadow Contrast Elements (Paolo Roversi Influence):
Strategic shadows on the face and body to create emotional depth. Natural shadows under the cheekbones, neck, and clothing folds to sculpt three-dimensionality.
Contrast Ratio: 60:40 (Bright:Dark) - softer than dramatic fashion, harder than pure natural light.
Maintains an overall soft atmosphere, avoiding overly dramatic effects.

Atmospheric Haze:
Visible light beams penetrating the mist in the background (Tyndall effect) to increase cinematic volumetric light effect.
Enhances the "homecoming poetry" atmosphere.
Creates a mysterious and hazy Oriental artistic conception. === Color Grading - Refined Editorial Palette === Main Color Tones (Based on Reference Image 2): Cinnabar Red (#C8402B) - Saturation 65% (Main color of the clothing).
Symbolizes "hometown warmth and cultural temperature."
Visual focus and emotional center of the image.

Ink-wash Gray-Blue (#8BA3B0) - Saturation 45% (Mountain mist atmosphere color).
Creates the "ink-wash poetic" texture.
Occupies a large area of the background.

Cream Off-White (#F5F0E8) - Saturation 40% (Pants, balancing the intensity of the red).
Represents purity and simplicity.

Accent Colors: Moss Dark Green (#4A5A48) - Saturation 50% - Stone railing transition element, connecting the figure and nature.
Natural Skin Tone - Enhanced but realistic, warm undertone.
Teaware Brown (Zisha #8B6F47) - Cultural prop details.
Sky/Cloud White-Gray - Large negative space to create a sense of breathing room.

Overall Color Grading Direction:
Soft richness - not overly saturated commercial film, not flat art film. Shadows: Slightly lifted (-0.15 lift value) to create a gentle atmosphere.
Highlights: Softened peaks, creating a film texture.
Midtones: Skin areas slightly warmed, background slightly cooled.
Contrast: Medium-high (78-82%) - three-dimensional without being harsh.
Color Harmony: Warm red (warm tone) vs. blue-gray mist (cool tone) forming complementary contrast.

=== Technical Execution - Hyper-realistic Film Aesthetic === Camera and Lens:
Medium format digital camera (Hasselblad H6D / Phase One XF). Sensor: 100 megapixels for extreme detail capture.
Lens: 85mm F2.0 or 50mm F2.0 portrait lens (selected based on composition distance).
Rendering: Film-like tonal transition, not clinically sharp digital clarity.

Film Simulation:
Kodak Portra 400 pushed one stop aesthetic. Strongly visible film grain (ISO 800 equivalent grain structure).
Organic texture throughout the image.
Slight halo effect on highlights (glowing edges of red fabric).
Natural color response, slightly warm neutral.

Texture Details - Key Requirements:
Clearly visible at normal viewing distance: Skin: Natural pores, fine lines, healthy texture, light retouching preserving realism.
Fabric: Weave texture of silk hidden patterns, natural wrinkles, sheen variation.
Stone: Rough moss texture, weathered surface cracks, lichen details.
Mist: Volumetric atmospheric layers, not flat overlay.
Hair: Strand texture, natural flyaways, fluffy feel.

Depth of Field Strategy:
Medium depth of field T2.8-T4.0. Main subject sharp from head to toe.
Foreground stone railing details visible but slightly softened.
Background Huangshan cloud sea mountains softly blurred, maintaining ink-wash layering and recognizability.
```

## 3020. 2x2 Grid Product Invention Visualization (Patent/Marketing)

- **id**：6466
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=6466

### 描述

A complex, multi-panel prompt designed to visualize the invention and marketing of a new product by combining two concepts (or evolving one). It mandates a 2x2 grid structure, with each quadrant requiring a distinct visual style: technical line art (Exploded Patent View), schematic diagram (Functional Diagram), photorealistic render (Product Render), and editorial layout (Marketing Pitch). The prompt acts as an industrial designer, focusing on cohesion between the panels and a minimalist, consumer electronics aesthetic.

### 示例图

![2x2 Grid Product Invention Visualization (Patent/Marketing)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1768717570742_yazze1_G-rI4thagAAXCjf.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Input Variable: {argument name="input objects" default="[INSERT 1 or 2 OBJECTS]"} 
Instruction:
Act as a Visionary Industrial Designer and Patent Clerk. Create a 2x2 Grid visualizing the invention of a new product based on the Input.
 Innovation Logic  :
Analyze Functions: Identify the primary utility of Input A and Input B.
The Fusion: Combine them into a single, cohesive device that solves a specific (niche) problem.
If 2 Inputs: Hybridize them (e.g., Mug + Grater = A self-cooling mug with a garnish shaver).
If 1 Input: Evolve it (e.g., Toothbrush = A self-sanitizing, toothpaste-injecting smart wand).
The Branding: Generate a catchy, corporate product name (e.g., "The Breeze-Grate™", "Solar-Brella Pro").
The Visual Structure (The 2x2 Grid):
CRITICAL: The image must be split into 4 distinct quadrants with different visual styles.
Panel 1 (Top Left): The Exploded Patent View
Style: Black & White Technical Line Art. Thin distinct lines, no shading.
Content: An isometric "Exploded View" of the device, showing the internal motor, battery, or mechanism separated from the shell.
Detail: Add Numbered Leader Lines (10, 12, 14) pointing to specific parts.
Panel 2 (Top Right): The Functional Diagram
Style: Black & White Schematic with bold arrows.
Content: A cross-section or "In-Use" drawing showing how how the device works. Use Action Arrows to show airflow, rotation, or liquid movement.
Detail: Show the "Result" (e.g., cheese falling, water spraying).
Panel 3 (Bottom Left): The Product Render
Style: High-End Studio Photography. Color, Glossy, "Apple/Braun" Design Aesthetic.
Content: The final physical product sitting on a white reflective surface. It should look sleek, using materials like White Ceramic, Brushed Aluminum, or Matte Plastic.
Context: Include a small prop to show scale (e.g., a block of cheese, a coffee bean, a hand).
Panel 4 (Bottom Right): The Marketing Pitch
Style: Editorial Magazine Layout. White background, black text.
Typography:
Headline: Large, Bold Serif Text displaying the [Invention Name].
Body: A block of clean "Lorem Ipsum" or readable text describing the "Revolutionary Features."
Bullets: A small list of specs (e.g., "Dishwasher Safe," "USB-C").
Visual Syntax:
Cohesion: The product design in Panel 3 must perfectly match the line art in Panel 1.
Design Language: Minimalist, Ergonomic, Consumer Electronics aesthetic. Even if the idea is silly, the design must look expensive.
Output: 2x2 Grid, Mixed Media (Line Art vs. Photorealism), 8k Resolution, "Kickstarter Campaign" Aesthetic.
```
