## 4190. Advanced Commercial Food/Product Poster Template with Vertical Layering

- **id**：3266
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=3266

### 描述

A highly advanced, structured prompt template for Nano Banana Pro (intended for use with Gemini) to create high-end commercial posters for food or products. The prompt uses a 'vertical layered suspension structure' to deconstruct the subject into components (ingredients, structure, final product) and includes detailed instructions for typography, lighting, material texture, and branding elements, all floating against a pure black background.

### 示例图

![Advanced Commercial Food/Product Poster Template with Vertical Layering](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936061940_vrcg7m_G82juViXQAEvJi0.jpg)

![Advanced Commercial Food/Product Poster Template with Vertical Layering](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936062570_gams8f_G82ju4GXMAAOMGl.jpg)

![Advanced Commercial Food/Product Poster Template with Vertical Layering](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936064427_3108dl_G82jvwAXMAAId1i.jpg)

![Advanced Commercial Food/Product Poster Template with Vertical Layering](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766936064268_0pgt4k_G82juViWMAAy54w.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Aspect Ratio: 9:16 Vertical
Image Style (Adjustable based on subject): High-end commercial photography, dark luxurious feel, cinematic texture, hyper-realistic, high detail
Background (Adjustable based on subject): Pure black background (#000000), no pedestal, no platform, no ground, all subjects and elements suspended in space
[Subject]
The core display subject is: [{argument name="core display subject" default="User provided subject"}]
It is mandatory to use your database knowledge and internet search to deconstruct the subject into multiple “identifiable, understandable, and hierarchical components.” Please determine the deconstruction logic and hierarchy based on the subject's characteristics.
[Overall Composition]
The overall composition uses a “Vertical Layered Suspension Structure,” forming a clear visual reading path from top to bottom.
There is a clear spatial gap between each layer, and layers are connected by air, steam, light, and shadow, rather than direct contact.
The visual axis is centered in the frame, making the composition stable yet dynamic.
[Title System (Top)]
At the top center of the frame, a high-end main title is suspended:
Copywriting content is automatically generated by AI based on the subject (can include Chinese main title + English subtitle)
Font Style (Adjustable based on subject): Handwritten brush calligraphy style / Natural writing feel
Material (Adjustable based on subject): 3D metallic texture, imitating forged gold metal
Feature Characteristics (Adjustable based on subject): Heavy, 3D, with realistic metal reflection, highlights, and shadow layers
[Layered Structure (Middle Subject Area)]
Based on the subject, autonomously generate 4–6 logically clear suspended levels, such as:
Raw Material Layer / Composition Layer / Key Element Layer / Core Structure Layer / Atmosphere or Emotion Layer
Each layer has clear material, color, texture, and volume
Air and space are left between layers; they are not crowded or stacked
All middle layers:
Are in slight steam, heat, or air turbulence
Have fine particles, mist, vapor, or dust floating
Are controlled by a unified lighting system, maintaining overall consistency
[Transition Zone (Important)]
Between the subject layering and the final presentation, deliberately reserve a “significantly larger spatial gap”:
This area is mainly composed of air, steam, smoke, energy flow, and light mist
No physical objects are placed here
The function is to create rhythm, breathing room, and visual contrast
To reinforce the transition “from structure to finished product / from process to result”
[Final Product Layer (Bottom)]
The bottom of the frame presents the complete, final form of the subject:
State is “finished state / peak state / most attractive presentation”
Texture is full, details are rich, with strong appeal or infectivity
Naturally blends with the background but clearly stands out
Steam, smoke, or energy sensation continuously rises from this area
[Information Annotation System]
Appropriately add descriptive annotations to the image:
Bilingual Chinese and English
Text is restrained and elegant
Use thin lines or arrows to point to the corresponding level
Annotation content is automatically generated by AI based on the subject
Does not overshadow the main subject, only serves for “advanced interpretation”
[Signature / Brand Element]
Bottom right of the frame:
A brand signature or signature Logo is suspended
Style is consistent with the main title (brush calligraphy feel, metallic gold, 3D, etc.)
Can be paired with slight starlight or shimmering effects to emphasize luxury
At the bottom, there is a one-sentence commercial hit SLOGAN tailored to the subject
[Lighting System]
Professional studio lighting at 45° angle
Warm contour light (rim light) outlines structural edges
Local highlights emphasize material realism
Steam and smoke are cut by the light, forming volumetric light
[Overall Temperament]
Dark tone, restrained, expensive, or on one side of the bottom (adjustable based on subject)
Possesses “soul / warmth / handmade feel / high-end commercial aesthetic”
Suitable for brand posters, key visuals, and cover-level commercial displays
```

Do this for {argument name="utensil" default="meat cleaver"}: 
Task: Pick a utensil that is uploaded or given, Transform it into a colossal, fully operational interstellar warship for an evil galactic empire.

Grid 3: A massive exterior shot of this utensil inspired ship in deep space. The ship is a brutalist, monolithic slab of dark metal, lit by the harsh, cold white light of a distant star. Deep chiaroscuro shadows. The ship’s surface looks like a practical miniature with heavy texture density, oil stains, and battle scars. Tiny, needle-like escort ships provide a sense of overwhelming scale. Ion-drive exhaust is a subtle, high-intensity white-blue glow.

Grid 4: An ultra-high-end interior shot of the bridge. Focus on three elite Imperial Enforcers standing in a minimalist gallery. Looking into the camera, their armor and weapons they are holding are heavily inspired by the utensil

Style: Tactical realism, shot on 65mm film, Denis Villeneuve brutalism, industrial design by Jony Ive, heavy on physical texture and high-contrast lighting, no digital sheen.
```

【Core Objective】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

which looks like:
- Something collected

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. Deduce the 【World Type】 to which the theme belongs
   (e.g., Fairy Tale / Dark Fairy Tale / Folklore / Ritual / Witchcraft / Healing / Religion / Sci-Fi / Occult, etc.)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 4301. Kickstarter Campaign Generator Prompt

- **id**：2791
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2791

### 描述

A detailed system prompt instructing the model to act as a Senior Product Designer and Crowdfunding Campaign Manager. It analyzes an input image's material properties to automatically select and generate a concept for a modern smart wearable (Jacket, Backpack, or Sneaker) and then visualizes the concept in a precise 2x2 grid layout suitable for a Kickstarter campaign page, including a hero shot, detail shot, lifestyle shot, and campaign UI mockup.

### 示例图

![Kickstarter Campaign Generator Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766385957583_svruzw_G8VpVYbXAAYij7H.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Act as a Senior Product Designer and Crowdfunding Campaign Manager.

1. ANALYZE INPUT
Look at the attached image. Determine the material properties (Soft vs. Hard), the primary colors, and the texture.

2. AUTO-SELECT SMART WEARABLE
Use this logic to choose the product category. The goal is Clean Modern Tech, not Cyberpunk.

IF the input is Soft or Fabric-like ({argument name="soft input examples" default="Ramen, Towel, Moss"})
GENERATE: The All-Climate Smart Jacket.
Features: Self-regulating temperature control, hydrophobic coating based on the input texture, and hidden magnetic pockets.

IF the input is Rigid, Boxy, or Container-like ({argument name="rigid input examples" default="Toaster, Book, Suitcase"})
GENERATE: The Ultimate Commuter Backpack.
Features: Integrated power bank with solar coating, anti-theft biometric zipper locks, and organized modular compartments.

IF the input is Mechanical or Footwear-shaped ({argument name="mechanical input examples" default="Stapler, Car, Tool"})
GENERATE: The Urban Mobility Smart Sneaker.
Features: Energy-returning sole technology, step-tracking sensors embedded in the heel, and auto-tensioning laces.

3. EXECUTE VISUALIZATION (2x2 GRID)
Generate a single image split into a precise 2x2 grid layout.

Top Left Panel (Hero Shot):
A clean, studio-lit 3/4 angle view of the product on a white or light grey background. It must look refined and manufacturable, using the texture of the input image as a premium material.

Top Right Panel (Detail Shot):
A zoomed-in macro shot focusing on a specific high-tech feature (e.g., a USB-C port, a magnetic buckle, or a waterproof seam) that shows off the input texture quality.

Bottom Left Panel (Lifestyle Shot):
A photorealistic shot of a fashionable model wearing the item in a clean, modern city setting (daytime). They look comfortable and stylish.

Bottom Right Panel (Campaign UI):
A mockup of a Kickstarter campaign page. It should show the product title, a green progress bar at 100% funded, and a bright green button that says Back This Project.

Overall Style: High-key lighting, soft shadows, 8k resolution, commercial product photography, minimalist design aesthetic.
```

## 4360. Cinematic Contact Sheet Generation from Reference Image

- **id**：2321
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2321

### 描述

A complex, multi-step prompt designed to generate a cohesive 3x3 cinematic contact sheet based on an uploaded reference image. It instructs the model to internalize the scene and subject, then create a sequence of images captured from multiple distances and angles while maintaining absolute consistency in subject, location, lighting, and emotional tone.

### 示例图

![Cinematic Contact Sheet Generation from Reference Image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766042091407_mbl36v_G8Y2JURa0AAf2eA.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Study the uploaded image carefully and fully internalize the scene: the subject’s appearance, clothing, posture, emotional state, and the surrounding environment. Treat this moment as a single frozen point in time.
Create a cinematic image set that feels like a photographer methodically explored this exact moment from multiple distances and angles, without changing anything about the subject or location.
All images must clearly belong to the same scene, captured under the same lighting conditions, weather, and atmosphere. Nothing in the world changes — only the camera position and framing evolve.
The emotional tone should remain consistent throughout the set, subtly expressed through posture, gaze, and micro-expressions rather than exaggerated acting.
Begin by observing the subject within the environment from afar, letting the surroundings dominate the frame and establish scale and mood.
Gradually move closer, allowing the subject’s full presence to emerge, then narrowing attention toward body language and facial expression.
End with intimate perspectives that reveal small but meaningful details — texture, touch, or eye focus — before shifting perspective above and below the subject to suggest reflection, vulnerability, or quiet resolve.
Across the sequence:
Wider views should emphasize space and atmosphere
Mid-range views should emphasize posture and emotional context
Close views should isolate feeling and detail
Perspective shifts (low and high angles) should feel purposeful and cinematic, not decorative
Depth of field must behave naturally: distant views remain mostly sharp, while closer frames introduce shallow focus and gentle background separation.
The final result should read as a cohesive 3×3 cinematic contact sheet, as if selected from a single roll of film documenting one emotional moment from multiple viewpoints.
No text, symbols, signage, watermarks, numbers, or graphic elements may appear anywhere in the images.
Photorealistic rendering, cinematic color grading, and consistent visual realism are mandatory.
```

### 描述

An extremely detailed, multi-section prompt for Nano Banana Pro to generate a 9:16 vertical, realistic fashion magazine cover photo. The subject, whose facial features must be 100% consistent with a reference image, is dressed in opulent Tang Dynasty court attire (Qixiong Shanqun, large sleeves, peony patterns, gold ornaments) and photographed against the backdrop of the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The prompt specifies lighting, color matrix (Tang Dynasty colors), pose (confident Empress), and magazine-level composition.

### 示例图

![Tang Dynasty Empress in Paris Fashion Magazine Cover Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1766042130660_ee2m3t_G8Wvo8sa4AkLDOE.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Generate a 9:16 vertical, realistic photo of 'Prosperous Tang Dynasty meets Paris': Use the uploaded FACE_REF as the character identity reference, 100% restoring the facial features and bone structure; the character is wearing a heavy-duty court gown in the style of a 'Tang Dynasty (High Tang) Imperial Concubine' (Qixiong Shanqun, large sleeves, peony patterns, gold ornaments), photographed at Trocadéro Square or the banks of the Seine beneath the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The image should have the photography, styling, and cover design quality of a COSMO fashion magazine, maintaining the magazine's consistent design style (English design).

【INPUTS | Input】 FACE_REF: The uploaded reference image for the character's facial features (Identity Lock)

【ABSOLUTE PRIORITY | Identity Lock (Highest Priority)】 100% restoration of FACE_REF's facial features and bone structure: Face shape, appearance, eye distance, nose bridge/alae, lip shape, jawline, and cheekbone structure must be completely consistent, without drifting. Realistic skin texture: Visible subtle textures and pores, avoid excessive smoothing or 'influencer' style. Adult female image.

【SHOT TYPE | Choose one of two shots (randomly selected by the model, must be truly consistent)】 A) Bust Cover: From the chest to above the waist, the headwear and upper body embroidery are clearest, eyes are sharpest focus (Primary recommendation) B) Full Body Cover: Complete presentation of the layered gown and skirt patterns from head to toe, stronger perspective of the Eiffel Tower's steel structure (Alternative) (Regardless of A/B: must maintain 'cover composition', with white space for layout, but no torn paper/hand-drawn effects.)

【LOCATION | Scene (Eiffel Tower, Paris)】 Eiffel Tower, Paris: Classic steel structure tower background. Choose one of two weather conditions (random): 1) Rainy Paris (ground slightly wet, soft light, high-end gray tone, strong fashion sense) 2) Brilliant Dusk (sunset glow, golden light and shadow, romantic atmosphere) Clean background: No tourists, no modern signs, no phone status bar UI, no watermarks/subtitles, no railings.

【LIGHTING & CAMERA | Photography Quality (Magazine Level)】 Lens feel: 85mm portrait quality (bust) or 50mm/70mm (full body), shallow depth of field, eyes in sharpest focus. Lighting: Natural light (emphasizing ambient light) + cinematic fill light; gold ornaments have realistic highlights but are not blown out; silk luster is clearly discernible. Color: High-end cinematic feel, French beige/blue-gray tones form a strong visual tension with the Tang Dynasty clothing's 'red, green, and gold' color scheme; overall clean, transparent, and rich in texture.

【WARDROBE | Tang Dynasty Court Gown (Plump, Flowing, Intense Colors)】 Target aesthetic: 'Ornate gold ornaments, facial makeup (mianye huadian), Qixiong skirt, flowing pibo (long scarf), intense red, green, and gold, extremely flamboyant.'

Silhouette and Layers (Must reflect Tang Dynasty characteristics) Inner layer: Hezi (bustier), exposing the neck and upper chest skin (reflecting the open atmosphere of the Tang Dynasty) Middle layer: Duijin short jacket (straight collar), transparent and light material (gauze/silk) Outer layer: Daxiu Shan (extremely wide sleeves, dragging on the floor), spread out like wings Decoration: Pibo (long silk ribbon), wrapped around the arms, fluttering in the wind Bottom wear: Qixiong Poqun (skirt waist tied at the chest, wide skirt hem, multi-color splicing or printing) Fabric and Craftsmanship (Heavy craftsmanship must be 'visible') Main fabrics: Silk, brocade, gold-printed gauze (combination of lightness and heaviness) Main techniques: Printing and dyeing (wax resist/clamping), gold thread embroidery, gold weaving Pattern themes (suitable for High Tang): Baoxiang flower, continuous peony vine, auspicious beasts (lion/kylin), Tuanhua (giant, full patterns) Details: Huadian (red decoration on the forehead), Mianye (red dots at the corners of the mouth), Armband (metal ornament on the upper arm) Headwear (Opulent Tang Dynasty headwear) Core structure: High bun (Yunji/Zhuaimaji), adorned with large peony flowers (real or silk) Decoration: Gold comb back (gold comb inserted into the bun), Buyao (swaying when moving), gold hairpin Earrings: Precious gold and jade

【COLOR MATRIX | Color Matrix Pairing (Must be executed, and must be 'Intense Tang Style')】 (Adjusted to Tang Dynasty popular colors: red-green contrast, brilliant gold) Randomly select 1 set from the following three 'Main Color Schemes' for the [Base Color/Large Area Main Fabric Color].

Scheme G (Stone Blue/Emerald Green Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 1" default="Emerald Green/Stone Blue"} (common intermediate color) Embroidery/Printing: Madder Red, Gold, Orange Yellow, Off-White Scheme A (Peony Red Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 2" default="Peony Red/Pomegranate Red"} (most classic Tang style) Embroidery/Printing: Gold, Emerald Green, Sapphire Blue, Purple Scheme R (Purple Base): Base Color: {argument name="base color 3" default="Purple/Grape Color"} (noble) Embroidery/Printing: Gold, Vermilion, Grass Green, Silver

【Color Execution Rules】 Color contrast must be strong, reflecting the grandeur of the High Tang, but the overall tone must be unified in a high-end feel.

【POSE | Cover Pose (Confident, Expansive, Queenly Feel)】 Bust: Head slightly raised, eyes looking down, one hand gently touching the bun or pibo Full Body: Arms spread out to drive the Daxiu Shan and Pibo, showcasing the volume of the clothing, full aura Expression: Confident, flamboyant, charming, generous; not shy.

【OUTPUT | Output】 1 vertical 9:16 realistic magazine cover-level photo Random: Bust or Full Body (A/B choice) Random: Rainy or Dusk (Weather choice) Random: Emerald Green / Peony Red / Purple (Color matrix choice) Styling: Tang Dynasty court gown direction + Peony flower/Gold comb headwear + Qixiong Daxiu + Pibo

## 4394. Vintage Action Figure Packaging Generator

- **id**：2228
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2228

### 描述

A multi-phase prompt designed to transform a subject into a vintage action figure, complete with packaging. It specifies converting the subject to semi-gloss ABS plastic with visible joints, inferring accessories based on their profile, designing a worn cardback with retro art and typography, and framing the final image as a macro shot of the mint-on-card toy found at a garage sale.

### 示例图

![Vintage Action Figure Packaging Generator](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991270665_k3nugt_G8GoTjRXEAEkUp2.jpg)

### 提示词

```
<instructions> 

1. Convert the subject's skin and clothing into semi-gloss ABS plastic textures. Visible joints at elbows and knees.
2. Analyze the subject's profession or hobby (or infer it). Generate 4 distinct "accessories" included in the bubble (e.g., a tiny plastic laptop, a sword, a coffee mug).
3. Determine if the vibe is 80s (Neon/He-Man), 90s (Grungy/Spawn), or 70s (Kenner/Star Wars), 2000 (appropriate style) or 2025 (appropriate style).

Phase 2: The Packaging Design
1. Cardback Art:The cardboard backing features a dynamic 2D illustration of the subject in an action pose behind the plastic bubble.
2. Wear & Tear: The card corners must be slightly frayed/white. The plastic bubble should have minor scratches or yellowing to simulate age.
3. Typography: Bold, explosive comic book fonts. Title: "THE [Subject's Defining Trait]".

Phase 3: The Shot

**Phase 1: Toyification**

2. **Wear & Tear:** The card corners must be slightly frayed/white. The plastic bubble should have minor scratches or yellowing to simulate age.
3. **Typography:** Bold, explosive comic book fonts. Title: "the [Subject's Defining Trait]".

**Phase 3: The Shot**
A slightly high-angle studio shot of the unpromoted toy resting on a wooden table or carpet, as if just found at a garage sale.
</instruction>

## 4448. Advanced Geolocation and Model Generation Prompts

- **id**：2005
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=2005

### 描述

A set of four detailed prompts used with Nano Banana Pro, integrated with Photoshop, to generate images based on specific geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude), focusing on mannequin poses, model generation, scene integration, and upscaling, with a requirement for high-resolution skin texture.

```
【Prompt (Mannequin Pose)】
Divide the screen into 6 equal parts and create genderless mannequins (without clothes or accessories) using 6 figure images, each with a different composition and angle.

【Prompt (Model Only Generation)】
Divide the screen into 6 equal parts and execute the prompt with 6 compositions and pose images of a female model in a white area. Upscale the skin texture to the resolution height of the female model so that the skin quality is visible.

【Prompt (Model and Scene Generation)】
Divide the screen into 6 equal parts and execute the prompt with 6 compositions and pose images of a female model and a white area. Do not use the blue-back background in the left area as is; faithfully reproduce the scenery of the location. The location is at latitude {argument name="latitude" default="35.31721720077321"} and longitude {argument name="longitude" default="139.5357227423284"}. Upscale the skin texture to the resolution height of the female model so that the skin quality is visible.

【Prompt (Upscale)】
Generate only the first image in the upper row of the image divided into 6 equal parts. Upscale the skin texture to the resolution height of the female model so that the skin quality is visible.
```

Ultra-realistic live-action photo of a hand holding a snack package. The background also shows shelves lined with different flavors and types of packages featuring the character from the reference image.

Character Name: "{argument name="Character Name" default="〇〇"}" (If not specified, strongly parody the characteristics of the reference image character with intense humor)

Snack Setting: "{argument name="Snack Setting" default="〇〇"}"

Realistic photo-style depiction of an original snack package fully decorated with the reference image character, held in a hand. The design should be natural enough to look plausible on a store shelf. The surrounding area of the snack should realistically show the store interior.

Snack Package Design:

Place the reference image character inside the package.
Emphasize the name of the snack with intense humor based on the characteristics of the reference image.
The package should be ultra-realistic, high-quality, and a highly stylish design that stimulates appetite.

Realistically reproduce gloss reflections and material texture.
Include an appetizing photo of the snack contents.
Parts other than decoration should be transparent vinyl, or have a transparent film window allowing the contents to be partially visible.

Place multiple humorous and exaggerated catchphrases and product names based on the reference image, using a font that reflects the atmosphere of the reference image, prominently.

Draw a background (sales floor) appropriate for the snack's worldview.
Also, ensure emotional and chromatic consistency between the background and the package concept.

📦 Package Shape Randomizer (Snack Package Shape Randomizer)

Regardless of the snack type, randomly select from the following package shapes with equal probability.
Furthermore, ensure the shape, background, texture, and light source are consistent.

◆ Shape Category List (Total 12 types)

Vertical bag package (Snack type)

Horizontal bag package (Chocolate bar/Candy bar type)

Box type (Small box) (Candy/Ramune type)

Box type (Large box) (Family pack type)

Blister pack (Gum/Gummy/with bonus item)

Cup container (Potato chips/Ice cream style)

Cylindrical container (Tube candy/Tower potato chips)

Stick type packaging (Long, thin candy type)

Jelly suction pouch (Drinkable gummy/Juice type)

Booklet type (Opens to reveal stickers or cards)

Toy integrated package (Built-in toy)

Eccentric shaped package
	Example: Character face 3D shape, car shape, treasure chest shape, glowing bottle shape, etc.

🧭 Scene Optimization (Scene Optimization Rules)

Automatically adjust the following to create an environment where contrast stands out and the package is highlighted, according to the snack package design and concept:

Lighting (Brightness, warm/cool colors, direction)
Seasonality (Summer/Winter, Spring/Autumn)
Indoor/Outdoor
Time of day (Day/Night)

Ultra realistic 8K extreme close up face portrait of a young woman with full facial alignment and identity preservation. Vertical 9:16 framing. No clothing is visible. Focus tightly on closed eyes, nose, and lips. Face slightly angled to the left side of the frame. Her face is partially submerged in a dark, rich rose-tinted liquid, nearly black beneath the surface, creating cinematic underwater shadowing. Wet black hair flows around the face with vivid neon pink tips reflecting softly in the water. Two hands gently touch each other near the side of her lips, interacting naturally with hair and skin in a neutral editorial manner. Surrounding the face, iridescent bubbles are artfully arranged to frame the face, creating layered depth and compositional interest. A small number of soft soap suds appear around select bubbles for texture. Hair strands float naturally, interacting with bubbles and light.

Mood and Concept:
Cinematic, immersive, and ethereal. Emphasis on editorial composition, layered textures, lighting, and color contrast. Extreme close-up highlights facial structure, bubble framing, and hair movement, with subtle leftward tilt of the face adding dynamic editorial composition.

Dewy porcelain skin with blush matching neon pink hair tips, applied on cheeks and temples for cohesive color harmony. Eyeshadow in soft pink-violet matching the hair tips, blended smoothly over closed eyelids. Gradient MLBB lips in a subtle rose tone. Fingernails in barely there tint with wet reflective quality.

Hair:
Wet black hair floating around the face with neon pink ends vividly visible and reflecting in the water. Strands interact naturally with bubbles and hands.

Accessories:
None. Only water, bubbles, soap suds, hair, and hands appear in frame.

Photography Specs:
Sony A1 with 90 mm macro lens
Aperture f2.0
Shutter speed 1/200 s
ISO 160

Dark liquid base maintains cinematic shadow depth beneath hair. Neon pink hair tips and matching blush and eyeshadow reflect subtly in water. Wet surfaces preserve natural sheen. Bubbles are arranged to artistically frame the face, enhancing composition and focus. Hands touching near the side of the lips provide compositional balance. - **id**：1472

### 描述

A detailed system prompt for Nano Banana Pro Agent V1.2, instructing it to act as a senior UI/UX designer. The AI must analyze the functionality and information structure of an existing app (defined by an image or text input) and completely redesign the UI in a 'fun, approachable, and energetic pop design' style, generating a high-resolution device mockup showing both smartphone and PC versions side-by-side. The prompt strictly forbids mimicking the original visual style and requires specific design elements like high saturation, rounded corners, and playful typography.

### 示例图

![UI/UX Redesign Prompt (Pop Design Style)](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765440134701_cuzxwq_G7uymHIbAAALvGt.jpg)

### 提示词

```
You are an experienced senior UI/UX designer specializing in new service launches and redesigns.

Analyze the attached image (or input text if no image is attached) and extract **only the 'functional requirements' and 'information structure'** shown there.
Based on the extracted functions, generate a high-resolution device mockup image of the app/service with a **completely refreshed design**, showing both the 'Smartphone version (mobile app)' and the 'PC version (Web dashboard or LP)' side-by-side.

**Important Requests:**
1.  **Design Refresh:** **Do not imitate** the visual style of the attached image at all. Propose a completely new design according to the 'Pop Design' instructions below.
2.  **Functionality Maintenance:** Core app functions, such as 'Upload,' 'Video Tiling Display,' and 'Export Settings,' must be included in the UI.
3.  **No Characters:** Do not place any characters or human illustrations in the image. Focus only on the UI and devices.

▼ Instructions for the Generation Process (Thinking Process)
Construct the design by executing the following thought process before drawing:
 * [Step 1: Extraction of Functional Requirements]: Identify what the service does from the attached image (e.g., video upload, tiling edit, output) and list the necessary UI elements.
 * [Step 2: Formulation of Pop Design Concept]: Define a vibrant color palette, playful shapes, and approachable typography based on the '▼ New Design and Style Specification' below.
 * [Step 3: Responsive UI Design]:
    * Smartphone Version: Optimize the UI using the defined pop design so that it is fun to operate even on a small screen. Buttons should be large and easy to press.
    * PC Version: Design a visually enjoyable grid layout utilizing the wide screen, using the defined pop design.
 * [Step 4: Spatial Composition]: Set an angle where the PC and smartphone are beautifully aligned, and the new design of both screens is clearly conveyed.

▼ New Design and Style Specification
 * **Design Direction:** Adopt **'Fun, Approachable, and Energetic Pop Design.'**
    * **Color:** Use a highly saturated, vibrant multi-color palette (e.g., candy colors, bright yellow, hot pink, sky blue) to give an energetic impression.
    * **Shape:** Frequently use large rounded corners for buttons, cards, and windows to create a soft, tactile texture. Icons should be in a playful style drawn with thick lines.
    * **Font:** Use an approachable and highly legible rounded Gothic Japanese font.
    * **Overall Atmosphere:** Finish with a bright, positive UI that makes the user excited to interact with it.
 * **Composition:** Cross-platform mockup with the PC and smartphone beautifully aligned, in an isometric (oblique overhead) or front view. The background should be a bright studio environment that enhances the pop UI.
 * **Text:** Place accurate Japanese text indicating the functions.

▼ Input Text (App Function Definition)
{argument name="app function definition" default="App to tile and export uploaded videos\nNo AI analysis function needed\nI want to be able to set the resolution!"}

### 描述

This is a detailed, multi-shot prompt designed for generating a 3x3 editorial photo grid in a clean, soft beige studio setting, specifically tailored for the 'Nano Banana Pro' style. It specifies character appearance, lighting, composition, camera settings (lens, aperture, DOF), and overall mood for nine distinct portrait shots, focusing on intimate, introspective, and character-led editorial minimalism.

### 示例图

![9-Shot Editorial Photo Grid Prompt for Nano Banana Pro](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765421886891_qpc6ze_G7lw2p6aIAAwTxV.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Editorial 3x3 photo grid in a clean soft beige studio. 
Character (matches reference 100%) wearing lightweight dark navy shirt, ivory trousers, barefoot for raw simplicity. 
Lighting: large diffused key light directly front-right, silver reflector left, subtle rim from top. 
Shots to include: 1. extreme close-up of lips + cheekbone with blurred hand partially covering (85mm, f/1.8, razor-thin DOF); 
2. tight crop on eyes looking into lens with reflection of light strip visible (85mm, f/2.0); 
3. black & white close portrait resting chin on fist, face filling frame (50mm, f/2.2); 
4. over-shoulder shot, blurred foreground fabric curtain framing half face (85mm, f/2.0); 
5. very close frontal with hands overlapping face, light streak across eyes (50mm, f/2.5); 
6. tight angled portrait showing hair falling into eyes, soft-focus background (85mm, f/2.2); 
7. crop of hands touching jawline, eyes cropped out (50mm, f/3.2, detail-focused);

### 描述

A highly specific prompt for generating product photography of an illustration reconstructed using ultra-clear, highly luminous tinted acrylic sheets. It mandates strict preservation of the original art style, detailed composition rules (base panel, metallic standoffs, clear margin), and material physics rules for light transmission and color. The lighting must be strong and cool, casting bright, glowing, highly translucent colorful caustics onto the wall.

### 示例图

![Layered Acrylic Artwork Product Photography](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765438504036_8im8am_G7jplU4awAAEuUy.jpg)

![Layered Acrylic Artwork Product Photography](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765438504163_i3ok09_G7jplU1bMAAK82k.jpg)

![Layered Acrylic Artwork Product Photography](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765438505760_bimern_G7jplUxa8AEvF3k.jpg)

The artwork is a physical multi-layered construction mounted on a white wall.
**COMPOSITION RULE:**
1. The aspect ratio and orientation of the final product photography should match the dimensions of the input source image.
2. A large clear base panel is secured with visible metallic standoffs.
3. Crucially, the entire die-cut illustration (all layers) MUST be contained entirely within the boundaries of this base panel.
4. There should be an appropriate clear margin between the edges of the illustration and the edges of the base panel.

**MATERIAL PHYSICS RULE (HIGH TRANSMISSION):**
On top of the base, the illustration is reconstructed using **ultra-clear, highly luminous tinted acrylic sheets** designed for maximal light transmission.
1. The colors are the color of the transparent material itself (glass-like), not painted.
2. **For Skin/White Areas:** MUST be **pure, colorless, ultra-clear glass-like acrylic**.
3. **For Colored Areas (Hair/Clothes):** Use **highly translucent colored acrylic**. The color is vibrant but extremely see-through, allowing significant light to pass.

**LIGHTING & SHADOWS:**
Strong cool diagonal lighting passes through the highly transparent artwork. **Instead of creating dark or heavy shadows, the light casts bright, glowing, highly translucent colorful caustics onto the wall, showing the wall's texture underneath.** The shadow area should feel light and airy, revealing the original colors as bright projections. 8k resolution, ultra-detailed.

## 4579. Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt

- **id**：1994
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1994

### 描述

A comprehensive Chinese prompt for Nano Banana Pro focused on editing an existing image to create a dramatic, photorealistic, ultra-wide-angle photograph. It requires strict identity and location preservation while allowing complete changes in camera angle, perspective (worm's eye, bird's eye, Dutch angle), and dynamic posing to emphasize foreshortening.

### 示例图

![Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991063523_5aptn0_G7jKx80aYAAwtja.jpg)

![Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991064165_scbewl_G7jKx8xacAAzN4p.jpg)

![Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991064057_ilbqwq_G7jKx9ma8AAsMiO.jpg)

![Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765991065599_wrb52k_G7jKx8zbsAAQDVq.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Ultra-Wide Angle Perspective and Dynamic Pose Remake Edit
This is an edit of the original image, not the generation of a new character.
Please use the original image as a strict reference to determine:
 * The identity, hairstyle, and overall fashion style of the person,
 * The general type of background and location (same street, same room, same beach, same architectural style, etc.).
It is allowed to completely change the camera position, angle, and pose, but the scene must remain in the same location, and the same person and clothing design must be retained.
Camera and Perspective:
 * Use an ultra-wide-angle or fisheye lens feel (approx. 12–18mm full-frame look).
 * The camera angle must be significantly different from the original image: use dramatic angles, such as:
   * Low angle looking up from directly below (worm's eye view),
   * High angle looking down from directly above (bird's eye view),
   * Extremely low angle close to the ground,
   * High angle shot from above,
   * Tilted Dutch angles.
 * Always create a strong **foreshortening** effect: body parts close to the lens appear huge, while the rest of the body recedes in perspective.
 * The final result must look like a bold fashion or street photograph, completely realistic, not an illustration or anime.
Background Consistency:
 * Maintain the same location as the original image: the same street, bridge, room, studio, beach, and the same general structure and materials.
 * Do not replace the background with a completely different place.
 * Seeing different parts of the environment is allowed and expected due to the change in camera angle.
 * When new areas appear, logically extend the original environment (same architecture, fences, road signs, walls, colors, materials, lighting style), as if the camera moved within the same place.
Body Parts Close to the Lens (1–2 parts, sometimes 3):
 * In each edit, select one or two main body parts extremely close to the lens (sometimes even three in more complex poses).
 * Vary between different images; do not always use the same body parts.
 * Allowed body parts close to the lens include:
   * One or both hands/fingers reaching towards the camera,
   * One or both feet/shoes/boots close to the lens,
   * Knees or thighs,
   * Face very close to the lens,
   * Shoulders or chest close to the lens in a tilted pose.
 * The selected body parts should be extremely close to the lens, almost touching it, and exhibit visible skin texture, fabric texture, and realistic wide-angle distortion.
Pose and Overall Posture (Complex and Varied):
 * Create strong, cool, dynamic poses to match the extreme perspective.
 * Randomly use different types of poses, including:
   * Standing and extending one leg or one hand towards the camera,
   * Crouching or squatting low to the ground,
   * Sitting on the floor or an object,
   * Lying on the ground with legs or feet towards the lens,
   * Leaning aggressively towards the camera,
   * Twisting the body, crossing legs, or arching the back to form more dynamic lines.
 * Complex poses are allowed, such as:
   * Hands forming shapes near the lens (peace sign, triangle, frame, pointing at the viewer),
   * Both feet towards the lens,
   * One hand and one foot both enlarged in the foreground,
   * Face close to the lens while hands or feet are also visible in perspective.
 * Maintain credible anatomy even with extreme foreshortening.
Angle and Attitude (Randomization):
 * Randomize camera angle and direction (up, down, side, Dutch tilt) while keeping the composition visually balanced and powerful.
 * Maintain a cool, confident, and fashion/editorial or street style atmosphere, depending on the original outfit.
 * Facial expressions can vary (serious, playful, confident, mysterious) but must still look like the same person.
Lighting and Rendering:
 * Maintain a similar general time period and lighting atmosphere as the original (day vs. night, indoor vs. outdoor, soft light vs. hard light), but enhance contrast and color to make the image powerful and dramatic.
 * Maintain realistic shadows and contact points with the ground or floor.
 * High resolution, sharp details, with clear skin texture, fabric weave, and material highlights.
Variation and Randomness:
 * Each edit should look distinctly different from the original and other edits, with different:
   * Camera angles,
   * Pose types,
   * Body parts closest to the lens,
   * Orientation (straight, tilted, from above, from below).
 * Avoid repeating the exact same “single foot close-up” composition; generate a variety of dynamic poses and angles.
Strict Rules:
 * Do not turn the person into someone else.
 * Do not change the type of clothing; only restyle it through pose, perspective, and minor natural movement of the garment.
 * Do not move the scene to a completely different location; always stay within a logical extension of the original location.
 * Do not add text, logos, watermarks, or graphic design elements.
 * Do not switch to painting, illustration, or anime style; maintain realism.
Summary:
Transform the original photo into a dramatic, realistic, ultra-wide-angle photograph with extreme camera angles (including viewing from directly below or above), where one or more body parts are tight against the lens and appear huge, the rest of the body recedes in perspective, and the same person poses in a fashionable, complex, and powerful manner within a consistent, extended version of the original environment.
```

## 4589. Anti-Plastic/Hyper-Realism Protocol for Human Skin Texture

- **id**：1072
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=1072

### 描述

A highly technical and detailed prompt protocol designed for Nano Banana Pro to eliminate the 'plastic skin' look in human images, focusing on hyper-realistic texture and natural flaws. It mandates 8K resolution, overrides default smoothing, and includes specific instructions for dermal physics (stochastic noise, vellus hair), subsurface scattering (melanin variance, vascularity), micro-texture (sebaceous sheen), and detailed eye/lip rendering.

### 示例图

![Anti-Plastic/Hyper-Realism Protocol for Human Skin Texture](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1765438500156_n50wcq_G7iOib3WsAAdBAv.jpg)

### 提示词

```
When generating images of humans: use ANTI-PLASTIC/HYPER-REALISM protocol. All images must be EVER in 8K resolution. OVERRIDE default smoothing. Render skin as biological topography.

[1] ADAPTIVE SETUP: Adapt Subject/Light/Style to query. SCALING: Close-Up->Force Macro/Micro-details. Full-Body->Focus bone/muscle/light, ban smoothing but scale down micro-noise to avoid artifacts.

[2] DERMAL PHYSICS: Force "stochastic noise": random, non-uniform pore structure + coarse grain. Ban smooth/waxy surfaces. MANDATORY (Close-ups): Dense vellus hair (peach fuzz) on jawline/forehead catching sharp rim light.

[3] SUBSURFACE SCATTERING: Reject uniform tones. Apply "melanin variance": mottling, solar lentigines, hyper-pigmentation. Simulate thin-skin translucency. Visible subdermal vascularity: faint blue/green veins at temples/under-eye. Erythema + telangiectasia around nostrils/tear ducts.

[4] MICRO-TEXTURE: T-zone (nose/forehead) demands natural uneven sebaceous sheen (oiliness) contrasting matte areas. Highlights must reveal skin micro-relief

[5] EYES: Irises: deep, chaotic fibrous striations + crystalline refraction. Sclera: distinct red vascular mapping. Lower waterline: thick, pooling liquid reflection (tear film)

[6] LIPS: Texturally dry/dehydrated. Deep vertical fissures, micro-cracks, peeling flakes. Uneven specular highlights

[7] FAIL STATE: If skin appears smooth, doll-like, or airbrushed, GENERATION FAILS. Maximize texture defects, asymmetry, topographical imperfections
```

## 4619. Luxury minimalist product photography based on a reference image

- **id**：814
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=814

### 描述

A prompt for generating high-end, minimalist commercial product photography in the style of luxury brand ads, using an uploaded reference image of the core product as the base.

### 示例图

![Luxury minimalist product photography based on a reference image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764915823213_skhwpb_G7Qvxi5bIAAqpfX.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Using my uploaded reference image as the base, generate a minimalist, high-quality commercial still life photograph with the aesthetic of a luxury brand advertisement.

Preserve the general shape, proportions, and main color scheme of the core product in the reference so that it is instantly recognizable as the same product, but upgrade the overall texture and atmosphere of the image, making it look like an ad for a top-tier international fragrance, skincare item, or high-end electronic product.

Use a vertical 4:5 composition. The background should be a large area of clean, neutral negative space, such as soft off-white, cool gray, or light beige, creating a quiet, restrained, and expensive studio environment. Apart from the core product and a minimal number of necessary supports, do not add any extra decorations. No clutter, no elaborate scene setup—only keep very simple geometric supports (such as a plain white cube, a cylinder, or a thin transparent panel). The supports must be simple and low-profile, existing only to hold and accentuate the product.

Strongly emphasize the material details of the product, and let the lighting fully serve those materials:
Show frosted glass with a fine, soft matte texture, ceramics with a matte or slightly glazed feel, and polished metal with clean, sharp specular highlights. Liquids should have clearly visible viscosity and volume. Avoid any cheap plastic feel, complex patterns, or gaudy stickers; the overall material quality must feel cool, restrained, and luxurious.

Use professional studio lighting: mainly soft, diffused light from softboxes, plus precise rim light outlining the product’s shape. The contours should be crisp and layered, and the shadows should be soft and clean, with no noise or dirty shadow patches. You may use a near-macro viewpoint, moving in closer to the product to highlight materials and details, while preserving ample negative space around the frame so the product can "speak for itself" in the emptiness.

Keep the overall color scheme neutral and calm. The product’s own color can be slightly more saturated, making it the single visual focal point in the scene. Do not use exaggerated gradient backgrounds, flashy colored lighting, or e-commerce promo aesthetics. No large-price text, labels, or cartoon graphics.

The final result must be a high-resolution commercial key visual that looks ready for a magazine back cover or a high-end brand announcement poster: minimalist, quiet, high-end, with the core product confidently centered, surrounded by clean negative space and precisely controlled lighting.
```

## 4624. 3D paper cut light box illustration framework

- **id**：810
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=810

### 描述

A detailed prompt template for generating dreamy, multi-layered 3D paper cut light box artworks, where you can swap in any theme and the model handles layers, lighting, color logic, and material realism.

### 示例图

![3D paper cut light box illustration framework](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764915832844_8io4zt_G7P9MJDbkAAyAdv.jpg)

![3D paper cut light box illustration framework](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764915835689_u3a0yh_G7P9MJDaAAA9-1Q.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Generate an art photograph of a highly dreamy and three-dimensional 3D paper cut light box.  
The paper cut theme is: {argument name="theme" default="a deer in a forest under the moonlight"}.

Layering structure and composition:
Design the image as a real, physical paper cut light box composed of 5–7 layers of paper stacked together. Each layer must have its own depth of field and clear silhouette, and you should be able to see the thickness of the paper and the shadows between layers.

Core structure:
- The image should clearly present a multi-layered silhouette effect, with visible physical spacing between the paper layers.
- Overall composition is vertical 3:4, with the light box centered, leaving a bit of space at the edges, like a glowing art object placed on a table.

Depth layout:
- Foreground (layers 1–2): use dark, intricate silhouettes that form a frame around the edges of the image, with elements matching the current theme, such as branches and vines for forest themes, windows and arches for city or castle themes, or rocks and coral for underwater or fantasy themes.
- Midground (layers 3–4): this holds the core subject of the theme, slightly central in the composition and taking up the main visual weight. The subject’s silhouette must be complete and not overly blocked by the foreground.
- Background (layers 5–6): use more simplified, lower-contrast silhouettes to show distant environment and structures, adding depth to the scene.

Three-dimensionality:
- There must be obvious physical spacing and shadows between layers. Light should pass between the paper layers to create soft gradations of light and dark, emphasizing the paper thickness and 3D depth, so it looks like a real paper cut light box, not a flat illustration.

Light and atmosphere (backlighting):
Backlighting:
- The light source must come from the very back of the scene, shining forward through all the paper layers.
- Light passing through the cutouts in each layer should form soft volumetric light and gradually decreasing brightness and contrast from back to front.

Color gradients (auto-adapting to the theme):
If no specific color scheme is given, automatically choose a main palette and gradient that fit the theme, while keeping a soft, night-light-friendly look. For example, warm gold to cool blue-green for forest themes, teal to deep blue for underwater themes, icy blue to deep blue for winter scenes, amber to electric blue for cyber cities, candlelight gold to deep indigo for castles, or deep blue to purple with golden glows for space themes.
If the user clearly specifies a color direction or mood (such as “cool sci-fi” or “pink-blue dreamy”), follow that as the top priority while maintaining the soft backlit, soothing feeling of a night light.

Overall feel:
The image should feel quiet, healing, and storybook-like, like a softly glowing bedtime story lamp, not a noisy neon poster or infographic.

Materials and details:
Paper texture:
- Emphasize the reality of heavy art paper: fine texture, slight visible fibers, clean sharp cut edges with visible thickness, and light that diffuses softly through the paper like a real fibrous material, not plastic or metal.

Physical light box photography feel:
- Present the image as a photograph of a real light box, not a flat illustration or vector graphic. You can faintly show the light box frame (simple white or light wood) and a slightly blurred tabletop or environment.
- The lighting should feel natural, with real-lens depth of field: slightly blurred foreground, sharp midground subject, and soft background.

Detail decorations:
- You may add a modest amount of tiny floating elements between paper layers to enhance space, such as tiny glowing dots, dust motes, snowflakes, bubbles, or other small particles relevant to the theme. Their number must be restrained so they only enhance atmosphere and depth without cluttering or disrupting the silhouette structure.

Technical parameters: vertical 3:4 ratio, high-resolution output.
```

## 4641. 3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image

- **id**：724
- **需要参考图**：是
- **画廊链接**：https://youmind.com/zh-CN/gpt-image-2-prompts?id=724

### 描述

A detailed Nano Banana Pro instruction prompt that analyzes one reference image and generates a coherent 3×3 cinematic contact sheet of the same subject with different shot types while keeping identity, clothing and lighting consistent.

### 示例图

![3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764577229402_u31t8z_G67jxidbkAcjDPL.jpg)

![3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764577234384_q6zk1s_G64FgZKXMAAXP_g.jpg)

![3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764577238747_2rpq2k_G64FgZGWwAAwXEl.jpg)

![3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764577242434_p205go_G64FgZXXcAAXmWw.jpg)

![3×3 cinematic storyboard contact sheet from one input image](https://cms-assets.youmind.com/media/1764577255872_35gd8v_G64FgZYXUAAg5Wf.jpg)

### 提示词

```
Analyze the entire composition of the input image. Identify all key subjects present (whether a single person, group/couple, vehicle, or specific object) and their spatial relationships/interactions.
Generate a coherent 3×3 “contact sheet” grid that shows 9 different shots of exactly these subjects within the same environment.
You must adapt standard cinematic shot types to fit the content (for example, if it’s a group, keep the group together; if it’s an object, frame the entire object):
Row 1 (establishing the environment):
Extreme long shot (ELS): the subject appears small within a vast environment.
Long shot (LS): the full subject or group is visible from top to bottom (head to toe / wheels to roof).
Medium long shot (American shot / three-quarter): framed from above the knees (for people) or a 3/4 view (for objects).
Row 2 (core coverage):
4. Medium shot (MS): framed from the waist up (or the central core of an object). Focus on interaction/action.
5. Medium close-up (MCU): framed from the chest up. An intimate framing of the main subject.
6. Close-up (CU): tightly framed on the face or the “front” of the object.
Row 3 (details and angles):
7. Extreme close-up (ECU): intense focus on key features (eyes, hands, signs, textures) with macro-like detail.
8. Low-angle shot (worm’s-eye): look up at the subject from ground level (epic/heroic feeling).
9. High-angle shot (bird’s-eye): look down on the subject from above.
Ensure strict consistency: the same person/object, same clothing, and same lighting must appear in all 9 panels. Depth of field should vary realistically (with background blur in close-up shots).

Create a professional 3×3 cinematic storyboard grid with 9 panels.
The grid should present a specific subject/scene from the input image across a full range of focal lengths.
Top row: wide environmental shot, full-body view, 3/4 cropped (knees-up).
Middle row: waist-up view, chest-up view, face/front close-up.
Bottom row: macro details, low angle, high angle.
All frames must have photo-realistic textures, consistent cinematic color grading, and correct framing tailored to the number and type of subjects or objects being analyzed.
```
